Per-frame draw of the title module: selects display-list layer 0, clears the screen, sets up the sprite render state and white colour, enables the font flag 1 and shadow, then draws by the draw copy of the state 0x08eea3fc (0x30 minigame result, 0x2f partner menu, 0x2d boot language, 0x29 save check, 0x22 language select, 0x10 options, 0xd minigame menu, 0xf wireless, 0x21 tab select, 0xb communication menu, 9 main menu, 8 name entry, 6 external cards, 5 title screen, 4 plays the opening movie, 3 logos; library states 0x15-0x1a draw nothing here), draws the fade (system_draw_fade; when it reports completion and the fade state 0x08eea400 is 1 sets it to 2) and commits the layer. After the commit it draws the overlays of library modules (deck tutorial 0x2c, tutorial list 0x18, module overlays for 0xf, limit list 0x1a, duel record 0x19, state 0x17 stub, card album 0x16, the opponent select of 0xd, the character list for 0xb/0x15/0x1d/0x1e and the recipe viewer for 0x14 when 0x08eeda19 is set, partner deck select 0x13), polls the name on-screen keyboard (state 8 sub-state 2) and runs save_update_utility_dialogs while a save dialog is active (states 0, 5, 8, 9, 0x29, 0x2d at the matching sub-states and steps). No return value. Side effects: the display list, the fade state 0x08eea400, system dialogs. Callers: 1 (ui_title_call_draw).

Draw step of the logo state: sets font scale 0x20 x 0x20 and white colour, then draws logo page 1 for sub-states 0-2, page 2 for 3-5 and page 3 for 6-8 (ui_title_draw_logo_page_1/2/3). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: font state, the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

Returns string index of title_msg_<l>.bin: card_db_get_dictionary_word(container_ehp_find_member(ui_title_get_menu_archive(), ui_title_get_message_table_name(0)), index) (the decompiler shows no return value; the accessor's result is passed through in v0). No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_title_open_title_message_box, ui_title_init_name_prompt_box).

Returns string index of the title message table selected by table (0 title_msg, 6 option_msg, 12 tushin_msg, 18 duelmenu_msg, via ui_title_get_message_table_name, in the title_menu archive). For index 1 and 3 the string is a format: it is printed with swprintf into the buffer 0x08eeda60 with the name of the card 0x08eec1c4 (card_db_get_name) and that buffer is returned (the card transferred in a trade, hypothesis medium). Side effects: writes 0x08eeda60 for indices 1 and 3. Callers: 5 (ui_title_open_popup_message, ui_title_init_bottom_message_box, ui_title_init_tushin_message_box, ui_title_draw_bottom_message_window, ...).

Loads the title_menu archive of the current language: when reload is 1 it first frees the current language slot (ui_title_free_archive(language + 4)) and stores the language chosen in 0x08eeda18 with save_set_language; then reads save_get_language into 0x08eeda14 and loads archive slot language + 4 (4-9 = title_menu_<j,e,g,f,i,s>.ehp, ui_title_load_archive). No return value. Side effects: heap and asynchronous file load, 0x08eeda14, possibly the saved language. Callers: 4 (ui_title_start_boot_language_select, ui_title_update_continue_load, ui_title_update_resource_load, ui_title_update_language_select).

Initialises the title menu context 0x08eede64 with the title_menu archive (ui_menu_ctx_init) and binds image 2 to it (ui_menu_ctx_bind_image(ctx, 2)). No return value. Side effects: writes the context at 0x08eede64. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_resource_load).

Starts loading archive slot: formats the path from the 0x40-byte path array at 0x08ee5bb0 (title_menu/title_menu_j.ehp, ...; slots 4-9 are the six languages, slot 3 the minigame result archive) into a stack buffer, gets its size on root 3 (container_get_file_size), allocates that many bytes from the module heap 0x08eea404, stores the buffer at 0x08eeda20 + 4 * slot and loads the file asynchronously with the bind callback ui_title_on_archive_loaded. Does nothing for a size <= 0. No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, file load, the slot array. Callers: 2 (ui_title_load_language_archive, ui_title_enter_mini_result).

File-load completion callback of ui_title_load_archive: when size >= 1 and buffer is not NULL binds the archive's members (container_ehp_bind_with_callback(NULL, buffer)), increments the title sub-state 0x08eea3e0 (which is how the load states advance) and returns 1; otherwise returns 0. Side effects: archive binding, 0x08eea3e0. No direct caller (passed as the callback of container_load_file by ui_title_load_archive).

Frees the buffer of archive slot (word 0x08eeda20 + 4 * slot) to the module heap 0x08eea404 (system_heap_free). The slot word is not cleared. No return value. Side effects: heap free. Callers: 2 (ui_title_load_language_archive, ui_title_update_language_select).

Returns the GIM name of image record index of the 0x98-byte image record table at 0x08ee7510 (name at +4; record 0 is the Konami logo). No side effects. Callers: 5 (ui_title_draw_list_menu, ui_title_draw_language_icon, ui_title_draw_language_cursor, ui_title_draw_logo_page_1, ...).

Returns the GIM name of sprite record index of a table of 0x16-byte sprite records: the byte at table + index * 0x16 + 1 selects an entry of the 0x40-byte GIM name array 0x08ee62f0. No side effects. Callers: 8 (ui_title_draw_fixed_menu_sprite, ui_title_draw_table_sprite, ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame, ui_title_draw_wireless_entry_frame, ...).

Returns entry index of the 0x40-byte GIM name array at 0x08ee62f0 (title_menu archive textures). No side effects. Callers: 4 (ui_title_draw_character_grid_faces, ui_card_trade_load_resources, ui_title_draw_sprite_number, ui_title_draw_character_grid_variant_arrows).

Returns the name of the message table record language + table (language 0x08eeda14) of the 0x84-byte record array whose names start at 0x08ee68b4 (title_msg, option_msg, tushin_msg, duelmenu_msg x six languages; table 0, 6, 12, 18). No side effects. Callers: 8 (ui_title_draw_message_aligned, ui_title_start_wireless_duel, ui_title_draw_message_text, ui_title_get_title_message, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_image(void *list, int kind, int index, int x, int y)
column3: Draws a title image at (x, y) with the record's own size: ui_title_draw_image_offset(list, kind, index, x, y, 0, 0, -1, -1). kind 0 selects the 0x98-byte image record table 0x08ee7510, otherwise the 0x16-byte sprite table 0x08ee4d70. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 10 (ui_card_trade_draw_lower_side, ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_slot_marks, ui_title_draw_external_cards_legend, ui_card_trade_draw_selection_marks, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_image_offset(void *list, int kind, int index, int x, int y, int du, int dv, short width, short height)
column3: Draws a title image with a texture-coordinate offset (du, dv) and optional width/height overrides (-1 = record value): ui_title_draw_image_full(list, kind, index, x, y, -1, -1, du, dv, width, height, 0xffffffff). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_image).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_image_full(void *list, int kind, int index, int x, int y, int extent_w, int extent_h, int du, short dv, short width, short height, uint color)
column3: General title sprite drawer: sets up the sprite render state, optionally the colour (when color != 0xffffffff), copies the record index from the 0x98-byte image table 0x08ee7510 (kind 0: halfwords +0x8c/+0x8e texture u/v, +0x90/+0x92 extent, +0x94/+0x96 size) or the 0x16-byte sprite table 0x08ee4d70 (other kinds: +0x0a/+0x0c u/v, +0x0e/+0x10 extent, +0x12/+0x14 size; GIM picked through byte +1), finds the GIM in the title_menu archive (ui_title_get_sprite_record_gim_name, container_ehp_find_member), emits its texture (field_3d_gim_emit_texture_frame0), sets the sprite extent (record extent; extent_w/extent_h override when >= 0) and draws the sprite at (x, y) from (u + du, v + dv) with the record size or width/height when >= 0 (system_ge_draw_sprite_flipped). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (ui_title_draw_menu_bar_label, ui_title_draw_image_offset).

Draws the first logo page: binds the GIM of the image record named by the index word 0x08ee4b14 (ui_title_get_image_record_name, title_menu archive) and draws the two image records whose indices are at 0x08ee4b14/0x08ee4b18, each from its 0x98-byte record at 0x08ee7510 (position +0x84/+0x86, extent +0x90/+0x92 with buffer size +0x88/+0x8a, u/v +0x8c/+0x8e, size +0x94/+0x96). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_logos).

Draws the second logo page: same as ui_title_draw_logo_page_1 with the two image record indices at 0x08ee4b1c/0x08ee4b20 (texture from the record of the first index). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_logos).

Draws the third logo page: binds the GIM e3_end_00.gim of the title_menu archive and draws the three image records whose indices are at 0x08ee4b24/0x08ee4b28/0x08ee4b2c from the 0x98-byte table 0x08ee7510 (same record fields as page 1). Calls save_get_language but ignores the result. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_logos).

column2: void ui_title_init_color_fade(void *fade, uint *target, uint end_color, ushort frames)
column3: Initialises a colour fade record: +0x00 = target (the colour word to animate), +0x04 = its current value (start colour), +0x08 = end_color, u16 +0x0c = frames, u16 +0x0e (elapsed) = 0, u16 +0x10 (running flag) = 0. No return value. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 2 (ui_title_handle_title_menu, ui_title_update_title_screen).
Starts a colour fade record by setting its running flag u16 +0x10 to 1. No return value. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 2 (ui_title_handle_title_menu, ui_title_update_title_screen).

Advances a running colour fade record by one frame: increments the elapsed count u16 +0x0e and writes into the target word (pointer +0x00) the per-channel linear blend of the start colour +0x04 and end colour +0x08 (each of the four 8-bit channels: start * (frames - elapsed) / frames + end * elapsed / frames); with frames (u16 +0x0c) 0 it writes the end colour at once. When elapsed reaches frames it clears frames, elapsed and the running flag. Returns the running flag u16 +0x10 (0 when done). Side effects: the target colour and the record. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_title_screen).

Starts a 16-frame black screen fade of the given kind (ui_title_start_screen_fade_black(kind, 0x10); kind 0 fade in, 1 fade out). No return value. Side effects: the system fade, 0x08eea400, 0x08eea3de. Callers: 13 (ui_title_update_wireless_menu, ui_card_trade_update, ui_title_request_state, ui_title_update_wireless_rules, ...).

Starts a black screen fade: ui_title_start_screen_fade(kind, 1, 0xff000000, frames). No return value. Side effects: the system fade, 0x08eea400, 0x08eea3de. Callers: 2 (ui_title_request_state_fade_duration, ui_title_start_screen_fade_default).

column2: void ui_title_start_screen_fade(int kind, uchar type, int color, short frames)
column3: Starts a screen fade unless one is already active (fade state 0x08eea400 non-zero): kind 0 fade in from black, 1 fade out to black, 2 fade in from white, 3 fade out to white (all with type 1 and 16 frames when frames == 0x10, else with type and frames), 4 fade in and 5 fade out with the given colour (system_start_fade_in / system_start_fade_out). Then sets the fade state 0x08eea400 = 1 and the pending state 0x08eea3de = 0xfff (no state change unless the caller sets one afterwards). No return value. Side effects: the system fade, 0x08eea400, 0x08eea3de. Callers: 2 (ui_title_start_screen_fade_black, ui_title_enter_logos).

column2: void ui_title_request_state_with_steps(int kind, short state, short sub_state, short step, short level3)
column3: Requests a state change at the end of a fade: ui_title_request_state(kind, state, sub_state), then sets the pending step 0x08eea3e6 = step and the pending third level 0x08eea3ea = level3 (0xfff keep, 0xffe increment, otherwise the new value; applied by ui_title_apply_pending_state). No return value. Side effects: the fade and pending words. Callers: 4 (ui_title_update_wireless_character_select, ui_card_trade_update_card_select, ui_title_update_wireless_deck_select, ui_title_open_wireless_slot_action).

column2: void ui_title_request_state_with_step(int kind, short state, short sub_state, short step)
column3: Like ui_title_request_state_with_steps with the pending third level set to 0: ui_title_request_state(kind, state, sub_state), pending step 0x08eea3e6 = step, 0x08eea3ea = 0. No return value. Side effects: the fade and pending words. Callers: 4 (ui_card_trade_update, ui_title_open_wireless_slot_action, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel, ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel).

column2: void ui_title_request_state(int kind, short state, short sub_state)
column3: Starts a 16-frame black fade of kind (ui_title_start_screen_fade_default) and sets the pending state 0x08eea3de = state, pending sub-state 0x08eea3e2 = sub_state, pending step 0x08eea3e6 = 0 and pending third level 0x08eea3ea = 0 (0xfff = keep, 0xffe = increment); ui_title_apply_pending_state applies them when the fade ends. No return value. Side effects: the fade and pending words. Callers: 30 (ui_title_update_main_menu_save, ui_title_update_wireless_menu, ui_title_enter_minigame_menu, ui_title_update_language_select, ...).

column2: void ui_title_request_state_fade_duration(int kind, short frames, short state, short sub_state)
column3: Like ui_title_request_state with a chosen fade length: ui_title_start_screen_fade_black(kind, frames), then pending state 0x08eea3de = state, pending sub-state 0x08eea3e2 = sub_state, pending step and third level 0. No return value. Side effects: the fade and pending words. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_logos, ui_title_enter_title_screen).

Returns the title fade state 0x08eea400 (0 idle, 1 fading, 2 fade finished; set by ui_title_start_screen_fade and ui_title_draw_state). No side effects. Callers: 9 (ui_title_update_wireless_menu, ui_title_update_wireless_card_gift, ui_card_trade_update, ui_title_update_comm_menu, ...).

Re-opens a list window: ui_list_window_reset(window) then ui_open_list_window(window). No return value. Side effects: the window list and the window. Callers: 10 (ui_title_init_menu_message_box, ui_title_open_title_message_box, ui_title_open_popup_message, ui_title_init_wireless_rules, ...).

Resets a list window (ui_list_window_reset), clears its 0x120 bytes and fills the title's default message-box descriptor: +0x4c = 1, position (0x27, 0xe0) at +0x58/+0x5a, size (0x191, 0x2e) at +0x6c/+0x6e, margins 0xc/0xc/6/6 at +0x90-+0x96, font sizes 0xd at +0x98/+0xa4, colours -1 at +0x70/+0x9c/+0xa8, +0xac/+0xb0 = 2, +0x7c/+0x88 = 1, the module heap 0x08eea404 at +0xc4, flag bits at +0xc8-+0xca, +0xcc = 2, +0xce = 2, +0xf0/+0xf2 = 0x179/0xd; then re-opens it (ui_title_reopen_list_window). No return value. Side effects: the window. Callers: 10 (ui_title_open_title_message_box, ui_title_open_popup_message, ui_title_init_wireless_rules, ui_title_init_tushin_message_box, ...).
Draws a list window into list (ui_draw_list_window with a stack copy of the list pointer) and returns the advanced list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_title_screen).

Draws a list window; when centre is non-zero first centres it on the 480 x 272 screen (+0x58 = (480 - width +0x6c) / 2, +0x5a = (272 - height +0x6e) / 2). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, may write the window position. Callers: 8 (ui_title_draw_name_entry, ui_title_draw_wireless_intro, ui_title_draw_save_check, ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby, ...).

Initialises a title list-menu record with defaults: state byte +0 = 0, +7 = 0, +8 = 8, +3 = 4, +2 = 0, +4 = 2, the list fade (ui_title_init_list_fade(menu, 4, 1)), the 10 item flags +0x3c-+0x45 cleared, geometry halfwords +0x46 = 0x80, +0x48 = 0x28, +0x4a = 0xf0, +0x4c = 0x20, +0x4e = 1, +0x51 = 5, +0x52 = 4, +0x57 = 0xff, +0x5a = 4, +0x5b = 1, +0x5c = 0xff, colours +0x60/+0x64 = 0xffffffff, +0x68 = 0xff000000, +0x6c/+0x70 = 0xff808080, flag byte +0x74 cleared, +0x7c = 0. No return value. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 7 (ui_title_enter_language_select, ui_title_open_main_submenu_0, ui_title_open_database_submenu, ui_title_open_deck_submenu, ...).

column2: int ui_title_update_list_menu_hold(void *menu, int arg, uint trigger_mask, uint hold_mask, int *out_held)
column3: Updates a list menu and reports whether the move was made with a held button: clears *out_held; when the menu state byte +0 is 3 and a button of trigger_mask was pressed this frame (pad word +4), it scans the 12 button masks copied from 0x08ee4b30 that are in hold_mask and sets the menu byte +0x75 when the button is also held (pad word +0), clearing it otherwise. Then calls ui_title_update_list_menu(menu, arg); unless the result is -1 or -3 it sets *out_held = 1 when +0x75 was set and clears +0x75. Returns the ui_title_update_list_menu result. Side effects: *out_held, menu +0x75, the menu state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_handle_main_menu).

Per-frame state machine of a title list menu (state byte +0): 0-1 opening (by the open style +4: 2 runs the per-item alpha fade ui_title_step_list_fade_in with base colour +0x60, 1 the stub open, 0 immediate), 2 when mode is 1 skips disabled items (item flags +0x3c.. value 1) from the cursor +0x55, 3 input: the confirm button (system_get_confirm_button(0)) selects the cursor item unless disabled (sound 0x7a05; flag bits 6-7 of +0x74 = 1; by the close style +5 either returns the cursor at once, setting the state to +3, or closes first), the cancel button (system_get_confirm_button(1)) unless the cancel style +6 is 4 starts a cancel close (sound 0x7a06, +0x74 bits = 2), Up (0x10) / Down (0x40) on the pressed word (or the repeat word +0xc when bit 1 of +0x57 is set) move the cursor over enabled items among the +8 items (sound 0x7a04, 0x7a07 when blocked; wrap-around when bit 0 of +0x57 is set); 4-5 closing; 6 returns -2 (cancelled), 7 returns -3 and resets the state to 0. mode 2 forces a state above 2 back to 2 (re-open). Returns the selected item index on the frame of selection, -1 while running, -2 on cancel, -3 when finished or idle. Side effects: the menu record, sounds. Callers: 8 (ui_title_update_deck_submenu, ui_title_open_database_submenu, ui_title_update_database_submenu, ui_title_init_main_menu, ...).

Returns a list menu from the post-selection state 4 to the input state 3 (state byte +0); other states are left alone. No return value. Side effects: menu +0. Callers: 3 (ui_title_update_deck_submenu, ui_title_update_database_submenu, ui_title_update_main_submenu_0).

column2: void ui_title_init_list_fade(void *menu, short frames, short stagger)
column3: Sets up the staggered fade-in of a list menu: u16 +0x0a = frames per item, +0x0c = stagger delay between items, +0x0e (elapsed) = 0, +0x10 (total) = frames + stagger * item count (byte +8), and clears the 10 per-item colours at +0x14 (0x28 bytes). No return value. Side effects: writes the menu. Callers: 6 (ui_title_enter_language_select, ui_title_open_main_submenu_0, ui_title_open_database_submenu, ui_title_open_deck_submenu, ...).

One frame of a list menu's staggered fade-in: while the elapsed count u16 +0x0e is below the total +0x10, sets for each item i (count byte +8) the colour word +0x14 + 4i to color's RGB with alpha 0xff * clamp(elapsed - stagger * i, 0, frames) / frames (frames +0x0a, stagger +0x0c), increments elapsed and returns 0; when done clears +0x0e/+0x10 and returns 1. Side effects: writes the menu. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_list_menu).

Draws a title list menu: advances the cursor blink counter (bits 0-5 of +0x74, cycling 0..0x3b while the state +0 is >= 3); for each of the +8 items draws a three-piece bar (left cap, stretched middle, right cap) from the image records whose indices are at 0x08ee4b60.. (0x98-byte table 0x08ee7510, GIM bound from the first) at x = +0x46, y = +0x48 + i * +0x4c with width +0x4a (minimum 9), coloured by the fade colour (+0x14 + 4i while opening), the disabled colour +0x6c or the normal colour +0x60, and picks the bar's texture cell from per-item style bytes (+0x4e, +0x56, +0x5a, cells of 20 x 24 in a 6-column grid; +0x58/+0x59 highlight a fixed item). The cursor item gets a second, pulsing pass whose brightness follows the blink counter (normal pulse 0xcf-0xff, fast flash on selection, black on cancel). Then calls the item callback +0x7c (list, index, x, y, width, height) to draw the item's text. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, menu +0x74. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_main_menu, ui_title_draw_title_screen, ui_title_draw_language_select).

Returns the text colour of list item index: the disabled colour +0x70 when its flag byte +0x3c + index is 1; the highlight colour +0x68 when the menu is in input or later state (+0 >= 3), index is the cursor +0x55 and the blink mode (bits 6-7 of +0x74) is 0 or 1; otherwise the normal colour +0x64. No side effects. Callers: 6 (ui_title_draw_main_submenu_0_item, ui_title_draw_main_menu_item, ui_title_draw_database_submenu_item, ui_title_draw_language_item, ...).

Writes the GE state for 2D sprites: clear colour/depth/stencil 0; with mode 2 disables states 9 and 1, texture function 4 and ambient colour 0x60000000 (a darkened variant, hypothesis medium), otherwise enables states 9 and 1, texture function 0 with alpha and ambient 0xffffffff; then nearest filtering, disables states 1 and 10, enables state 4 (blending) with blend function (add, src alpha, one minus src alpha) and colour 0xffffffff. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 15 (ui_title_draw_state, ui_title_draw_language_cursor, ui_title_draw_scrollbar, ui_title_draw_table_sprite, ...).

Leaves the title module for another scene: clears the scene frame callbacks (system_scene_set_frame_callback(NULL, NULL, NULL)), shows the loading overlay, waits one frame and calls system_scene_call(0xd, scene, arg) (0xd = the title scene). Returns scene. Side effects: scene switch, loading overlay. Callers: 8 (ui_title_start_wireless_duel, ui_title_start_comm_duel, ui_title_start_duel_type_3, ui_minigame_menu_launch_game, ...).

Starts a quick duel between two random opponents (title state 0x23): fills the duel set-up buffer (deck_get_duel_setup_buffer) with mode +0x190 = 5, +0x191 = 1, single duel +0x192 = 1, +0x196/+0x197 = 0, a random seed +0x188, a random first player +0x18c, +0x1a0 = 0 and BGM set +0x194 = 3 or 1 at random; copies the 8 character ids at 0x08ee4b70 and the 8 recipe ids at 0x08ee4b90, shuffles the pairs with system_rand_shifted and writes the first two pairs to duellist records 0 and 1 (character +0x1a4, variant 0, recipe +0x1ac); then duel_setup_load_decks and scene 6 (duel). No return value. Side effects: the set-up buffer, deck loading, scene switch. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Starts a set-up of mode 3 (title state 0x24): set-up buffer +0x190 = 3, +0x193 = the title step 0x08eea3e4 (the lesson/entry index chosen, hypothesis medium), BGM set +0x194 = 3; switches to scene 6 without loading decks here. No return value. Side effects: the set-up buffer, scene switch. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Maps a communication rule value to the duel set-up LP/rule byte: 0 -> 1, 1 -> 2, 2 -> 0, 3 -> 3, 4 -> 4, anything else 0. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_title_build_wireless_duel_setup, ui_title_start_wireless_duel, ui_title_start_comm_duel).

Builds the duel set-up for a duel arranged on the communication screens and starts it (title state 0x25): clears the four duellist character words, +0x195 = 2, mode +0x190 = 6 when bit 1 of 0x08eec391 is set else 1, tag (+0x192 = 2, four duellists) when bits 5-6 of the rules byte 0x08eebfdc are 1 else single (two duellists), +0x191 = 2 when bit 7 of 0x08eebfdc is set (match, hypothesis medium) else 1, LP setting +0x196 from bits 1-4 of 0x08eebfdd (ui_title_map_rule_to_duel_setting), +0x197 = low nibble of 0x08eebfde, BGM set 1, random seed and first player. For each duellist reads the chosen slot (ui_title_get_duel_setup_slot, copied with ui_title_copy_duel_setup_slot): non-player characters get their recipe (or code 466 when the recipe is 462); the player (or character 0x2e) gets by source kind 2 code 462 with the deck name and deck copied from 0x08eed6d4/0x08eed614 + 0x100 * i (an external deck), 1 the given recipe, 0 code 465 (current deck) or 463 with stored deck value - 1. Loads the decks (duel_setup_load_decks), flags cards exceeding the owned count in the player's deck (deck_flag_cards_exceeding_owned, with side deck when +0x191 is 2), frees the set-up panel and switches to scene 6. No return value. Side effects: the set-up buffer, decks, scene switch. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Copies a 0x18-byte duel set-up slot record (seven halfwords +0x00-+0x0c: character, variant, ..., source kind +0x08, value +0x0a; and the words +0x10/+0x14). Returns dst. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 11 (ui_title_load_wireless_external_decks, ui_title_enter_wireless_deck_select, ui_title_enter_comm_tag_duel, ui_title_update_comm_tag_duel, ...).

Starts a set-up of mode 2 (title state 0x2b): set-up buffer +0x193 = 0x08eeac74 - 8, +0x195 = 0, +0x190 = 2, single duel (+0x192 = 1), +0x191 = 1, +0x196/+0x197 = 0, BGM set 1, random seed and first player; switches to scene 6. No return value. Side effects: the set-up buffer, scene switch. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

column2: void ui_title_bind_layout(int slot, int mode, int start, int end)
column3: Looks up layout slot's .ehf in the title_menu archive (name from the 0x40-byte array at 0x08ee5e30: main_title01.ehf, ...), stores the pointer in the layout slot array 0x08eea484 + 4 * slot and sets its play range (ui_title_set_layout_range(slot, mode, start, end)). No return value. Side effects: the slot array, the layout player. Callers: 33 (ui_card_trade_load_resources, ui_title_update_wireless_card_gift, ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ui_minigame_menu_init, ...).

column2: void ui_title_set_layout_range(int slot, int mode, int start, int end)
column3: Sets the play range of the layout in slot (0x08eea484 + 4 * slot) when it is bound: mode 1 or 2 plays frames start..end (ui_ehf_set_play_range(ehf, start, end + 1)), mode 0 holds frame start (start..start + 1). No return value. Side effects: the layout player. Callers: 23 (ui_title_update_name_entry_confirm, ui_title_update_language_select, ui_title_update_comm_single_duel, ui_title_update_comm_tag_duel, ...).

Returns the current frame of the layout in slot (ui_ehf_get_current_frame on 0x08eea484 + 4 * slot), or -1 when the slot is empty. No side effects. Callers: 23 (ui_title_update_name_entry_confirm, ui_title_update_language_select, ui_title_update_comm_tag_duel, ui_title_update_tab_select, ...).

Draws the layout bound to slot (0x08eea484 + 4 * slot) when present: builds a zeroed 0x60-byte draw-parameter block whose first word is the frame timing value (system_get_frame_timing), and wraps ui_ehf_draw in ui_ehf_begin_draw / ui_ehf_end_draw. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, advances the layout player. Callers: 20 (ui_title_draw_deck_select_list, ui_title_draw_comm_menu, ui_title_draw_language_select, ui_title_draw_wireless_rules, ...).

Draws the screen-title label on the menu bar for the current state 0x08eea3dc: picks the bar layout slot (0xe for most menus, 0x10 for state 0xb, 0xf for 0xf, 0x12 for wireless sub-state 0xe), and the label's texture row (v offset in steps of 0x15: main menu 9 -> 0, name entry 8 -> 0x15, external cards 6 -> 0x2a, minigame/tab select 0x3f, options 0x54, language 0x69; for states 0xb and 0xf by sub-state); draws sprite 0x6f/0x70 of the 0x16-byte sprite table with ui_title_draw_image_full only while the bar layout's frame is between 6 and its end frame (0x61, or 0x36 for 0xb/0xf), with a half-transparent tint 0x80ffffff and a 10-pixel height at the first and last frame. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 17 (ui_title_draw_language_select, ui_title_draw_wireless_rules, ui_title_draw_name_entry, ui_title_draw_tab_select, ...).

When bit 4 of the flag byte 0x08eeda48 is set (a library module is loaded), unloads module id 0x08eeda4c (system_module_unload) and clears the bit. No return value. Side effects: module unload, 0x08eeda48. Callers: 18 (ui_title_update_charalist, ui_minigame_menu_launch_game, ui_title_update_recipe_viewer, ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_message_text(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int table, uint index)
column3: Draws string index of title message table table (ui_title_get_message_table_name, card_db_get_dictionary_word in the title_menu archive) at (x, y) with width through ui_title_draw_text. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_new_game_box_text).

column2: void ui_title_get_message_centered(int x, int width, int table, uint index, ushort **out_text, int *out_x, int *out_width)
column3: Fetches string index of title message table table and centres it in a field: *out_text = the string, *out_width = its measured width (system_font_measure_string >> 6, i.e. pixels), *out_x = x + (width - text width) / 2. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_language_item).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_message_styled(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int table, uint index, int align, int scale_x, int scale_y, uint color)
column3: Sets the font scale (scale_x, scale_y), colour and shadow, then draws a title message with ui_title_draw_message_aligned(list, x, y, width, table, index, align). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: font state, the display list. Callers: 13 (ui_title_draw_deck_select_list, ui_title_draw_comm_bottom_caption, ui_title_draw_wireless_card_gift_caption, ui_title_draw_wireless_top_caption, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_message_aligned(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int table, uint index, int align)
column3: Draws string index of title message table table (0 title_msg, 6 option_msg, 12 tushin_msg, 18 duelmenu_msg; title_menu archive) with ui_title_draw_text_with_align(list, x, y, width, 0, text, align). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 13 (ui_title_draw_tab_select_tab, ui_title_draw_deck_submenu_item, ui_title_draw_external_cards_caption, ui_title_draw_database_submenu_item, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_text_with_align(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, ushort *text, int align)
column3: Draws UTF-16 text in a field with an alignment mode: 1 centres the text (x += (width - text width) / 2, width = text width), 3 centres only when it fits and otherwise shrinks it to the width, 2 fits to the width (ui_title_draw_text_fit_width), 4 draws a wrapped text box of height (ui_title_draw_text_box), 0 and 1 plain (ui_title_draw_text). Text widths come from system_font_measure_string >> 6. Returns the advanced display list (list unchanged for other modes). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (ui_title_draw_list_window, ui_title_draw_message_aligned).

Starts story mode (title states 0x1b/0x1c pass cycle 0/1): reads the partner field (save_copy_partner_field); with cycle non-zero stores it as the story cycle (save_set_story_cycle); the values derived from the partner field when cycle or arg is 0 (bits 1-3 and bits 4-11) are computed but unused; then switches to scene 2 (story). No return value. Side effects: save story cycle, scene switch. Callers: 2 (ui_title_enter_state, ui_title_update_charalist_select).
Clears the popup message state 0x08eea3ec (0 = closed). No return value. Side effects: writes 0x08eea3ec. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_load_resources).

column2: void ui_title_open_popup_message(void *window, int table, int index, int buttons, int default_choice)
column3: Opens a popup message in a list window: initialises it as a title message box (ui_title_init_message_box) with margins 10/8 and font size 0xc; message 0x73 uses a fixed layout (position 0x95,0x18, extent 0x149 x 0xf4, auto size), others sit at (0x3c, 100) with size 0x168 x 0x68; the text is message index of table (ui_title_get_message) formatted with swprintf into 0x08eeda60 and stored at +0x84; the button set comes from buttons (1: choice set 3 with default 2 or 3, 2: set 2 with default 1 or 4, 3: set 1, otherwise no buttons, the last two with flag bit 2 of +0xc8), stored in the nibbles of +0xca/+0xd3 and byte +0xd4; then re-opens it (ui_title_reopen_list_window). No return value. Side effects: the window, 0x08eeda60. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_popup_message).

column2: int ui_title_update_popup_message(void *window, int table, int index, int buttons, int default_choice)
column3: Runs a popup message (state 0x08eea3ec, last result 0x08eea3ee, current table/index 0x08eea3f0/0x08eea3f4): when a different (table, index) is requested while one is open, cancels and closes the old one first (returning 0 until it is closed); state 0 opens it (ui_title_open_popup_message) and remembers table/index, 1 waits for the window to finish opening (state byte +0xe9 >= 3), 2 updates it (when it has buttons) and on results -2 or 1-5 moves to 3, 3 keeps updating until it closes. When the window state byte +0xe9 reaches 6 (closed) returns the stored result and resets the popup state. Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: the window, 0x08eea3ec-0x08eea3f4. Callers: 2 (ui_card_trade_update_steps, ui_card_trade_update_picker_result).

Draws the popup message window while the popup state 0x08eea3ec is 1-3; with centre non-zero first centres it on the 480 x 272 screen (+0x58/+0x5a from the size +0x6c/+0x6e). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, may write the window position. Callers: 2 (ui_title_draw_module_overlays, ui_card_trade_draw).

When a popup is opening or waiting (state 0x08eea3ec 1 or 2), sets the state to 3 with result 0xfffe (cancelled), starts closing the window (ui_list_window_start_close) and updates it once. No return value. Side effects: the window, 0x08eea3ec/0x08eea3ee. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_popup_message, ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Sets the title state 0x08eea3dc = state and clears the sub-state 0x08eea3e0, with no fade or set-up (used for the partner menu state 0x2f). No return value. Side effects: those words. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Title state 0x2f: sub-state 0 creates the partner menu with the module heap 0x08eea404 and the title_menu archive (ui_partner_menu_create(heap, archive, 0, 0)) and advances; 1 runs ui_partner_menu_update and goes to sub-state 10 when it returns 2; 10 destroys the menu (ui_partner_menu_destroy). Copies the sub-state to 0x08eea3fe. No return value. Side effects: the partner menu, title sub-state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_state).
Draws the partner menu (ui_partner_menu_draw) once the sub-state 0x08eea3e0 is non-zero. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

Enters the minigame result state 0x30: stores state, clears the sub-state, starts loading archive slot 3 (the minigame result archive, ui_title_load_archive(3)) and sets the sub-state to 1 (the load callback raises it to 2). No return value. Side effects: heap, file load, title state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Title state 0x30, by sub-state 0x08eea3e0: 2 (archive loaded) creates the result screen with the heap 0x08eea404, the result archive 0x08eeda2c, mode 2 and a parameter block {100, 0x8e94, 1} (ui_mini_result_create) and advances; 3 runs ui_mini_result_update (3 -> sub-state 0xb, 2 -> sub-state 10); 0xb destroys it (called twice) and enters the title screen (5); 10 destroys it (twice) and enters the main menu (9). Copies the sub-state to 0x08eea3fe. Returns 0x30. Side effects: the result screen, title state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_state).
Draws the minigame result screen (ui_mini_result_draw) once the sub-state 0x08eea3e0 is above 2. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

Enters the title screen (state 5): with sub_state 0xc (returning to the menu) sets the colours 0x08eea424 = 0xff404040 and 0x08eea428 = white, requests a fade-in to state 5 sub-state 4 (the title menu), initialises and runs the title menu once; with sub_state 0 sets both colours white and requests a 30-frame fade-in with an incremented sub-state. Both store state/sub_state and clear the step and timer. Then binds layout 0 (main_title01, frames 0..end) and layout 1 (frames 0..0x77) and, unless sub_state is 9, starts BGM track 0 (audio_play_track_with_fade). No return value. Side effects: title state, colours, layouts, BGM. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Title state 5 by sub-state 0x08eea3e0, keeping layout 0 looping frames 100-1099: 1 plays a random title-call voice (sound 0x79c2 + rand % 0x1c, kept in 0x08eeda1c) when the language is 0, then 2 waits on the press-start colour fade 0x08eea434; Start or confirm plays 0x7a05, jumps layout 0 to frame 100 if needed, plays layout 1 frames 0x78-0xa4, fades the press-start colour 0x08eea424 to 0xff404040 over 15 frames and advances with return sub-state 4; after 0x3de idle frames returns to the logos (state 3) or, when bit 2 of 0x08eeda48 is set, to state 0x23 (random demo duel), fading the BGM out over 600. 3 waits for the colour fade, initialises the title menu and goes to the stored sub-state; 4 runs the title menu (ui_title_handle_title_menu); 5-6 the continue load; 7 the new-game confirmation box; 8 the new-game save probe; 0xb requests state 0x1f (new game) once. Copies the sub-state to 0x08eea3fe. No return value. Side effects: title state, layouts, sounds, BGM, colour fade. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_state).

Draws the title screen unless the sub-state is 5, 6 or 9: layout 0 (background), then layout 1 (press start) for sub-states 2, 3, 0xb, the title menu list 0x08eeac84 (ui_title_draw_list_menu) for 4 and 0xc, or the message box 0x08eea594 for sub-state 7 once the step is above 2; increments the frame timer 0x08eea3d8. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, 0x08eea3d8. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

Initialises the title menu list 0x08eeac84 (ui_title_init_list_menu): byte +7 = 0, the cursor +0x55 (0x08eeacd9) starts on item 1 when save_get_task_status_flag() is non-zero (a save exists, hypothesis medium), item count +8 = 2 (items 2 and 3 handled by ui_title_handle_title_menu are then unreachable unless the count is changed elsewhere), geometry x 0x8c, y 0xc1, width 200, spacing 0x18, a 4-frame fade with stagger 1 and the item drawer ui_title_draw_title_menu_item at +0x7c. No return value. Side effects: the menu record. Callers: 2 (ui_title_enter_title_screen, ui_title_update_title_screen).

Title menu input (title screen sub-state 4) by step 0x08eea3e4: steps 0-1 update the list 0x08eeac84; item 0 requests the name entry (state 8) and initialises a new game (save_init_new_game), item 1 requests sub-state 5 (continue load), item 2 sub-state 9, item 3 the external-cards state 6; cancel (-2) fades the press-start colour back to white over 15 frames, returns to sub-state 2 and replays layout 1 frames 0..0x77. Step 2 stops the title-call voice 0x08eeda1c (audio_stop_sound(voice, 1000)). No return value. Side effects: title state, save state, sounds. Callers: 2 (ui_title_enter_title_screen, ui_title_update_title_screen).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_title_menu_item(void *list, ushort index, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Item callback of the title menu list 0x08eeac84: unless the list is still opening with item index's fade colour not yet opaque, draws title message 0x1e + index (table 0, centred, align 1) at (x, y + 3) with font scale 0xf and the colour from ui_title_get_list_item_color. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: font state, the display list. No direct caller (stored at menu +0x7c by ui_title_init_title_menu and called by ui_title_draw_list_menu).

Initialises the message box 0x08eea594 as the new-game confirmation: title message-box defaults (ui_title_init_message_box), byte +0x54 = 2, +0xac/+0xb0 = 2, position (0x50, 0x60), size 300 x 0x60, +0xa0 = 0, flags of +0xc8 cleared, content callback ui_title_draw_new_game_box_text at +0x100; re-opens it. No return value. Side effects: the window 0x08eea594. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_new_game_box).

Title screen sub-state 7 by step 0x08eea3e4: 0 starts a fade-in without a state change and pending step 2; 2 opens the new-game box (ui_title_init_new_game_box) and goes to 3; 3 updates the window: result 0 requests the name entry (state 8), -2 returns to the title screen (state 5), both setting step 4. No return value. Side effects: the window, title state, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_title_screen).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_new_game_box_text(void *list, int x, int y)
column3: Content callback of the new-game box: font scale 0xe, white, and draws title message 0x1e (table 0) at (x, y) with width 0x100 (ui_title_draw_message_text). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: font state, the display list. No direct caller (stored in the window by ui_title_init_new_game_box).

Title screen sub-state 8 by step 0x08eea3e4: 0 opens save request 1 with the heap 0x08eea404, 1 waits for save_update_task to return 2 or 3, 2 advances, 3 enters the name entry (state 8, sub-state 0). No return value. Side effects: the save task, title state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_title_screen).

Continue path of the title screen (sub-states 5-6) by step 0x08eea3e4: 0-2 record the current language in 0x08eeda14 and open save request 4 (load) with the heap 0x08eea404; 3 waits for save_update_task: 3 (failure) -> step 7, 2 (success) applies the saved volumes (audio_title_apply_saved_volumes) -> step 4; 4 compares the loaded save's language with 0x08eeda14 (storing it in 0x08eeda18): same -> starts card_db_load_cardinfo, otherwise reloads the title archive in the new language (ui_title_load_language_archive(1)), both under the loading overlay; 5 waits for the archive (sub-state 6) and then loads the card info; 6 waits for card_db_bind_cardinfo, hides the overlay and enters the main menu (state 9); 7 returns to the title screen (state 5). Copies the sub-state to 0x08eea3fe. No return value. Side effects: save load, language archive, card info, overlay, title state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_title_screen).

Enters the tab-select state 0x21: clears the step and timer, sets both title colours 0x08eea424/0x08eea428 to white, stores state/sub_state, initialises the tab menu 0x08eea8f4 (ui_title_init_tab_select_menu) and binds layout slots 5 and 6 (frames 0..0x1e0) and the menu-bar layout 0xe (frames 0..0x10). No return value. Side effects: title state, the menu, layout slots. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Title state 0x21 by sub-state: 0 requests a fade-in with pending sub-state 2; 2 waits for the menu-bar layout 0xe to reach frame 0x10 and then plays frames 0x11-0x60 (sub-state 3); 3 updates the menu 0x08eea8f4 (ui_title_update_menu): cancel (-2) requests the main menu (state 9, sub-state 0xc), a selection requests state 0x24 (duel set-up of mode 3, ui_title_start_duel_type_3) with the current tab byte 0x08eeac02 as sub-state and the selected item as pending step (it becomes set-up +0x193); both set sub-state 4. Copies the sub-state to 0x08eea3fe. No return value. Side effects: title state, the fade, layout 0xe. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_state).

Draws the tab-select screen: layouts 6 and 5, then (from sub-state 2) the menu-bar layout 0xe and its label (ui_title_draw_menu_bar_label); sets bit 2 of the menu flag byte 0x08eea99e (input-inactive look, hypothesis medium) except in sub-state 3, where it is cleared together with the cursor-frame callback word 0x08eeaac4; draws the menu 0x08eea8f4 (ui_title_draw_menu) and increments the timer 0x08eea3d8. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, 0x08eea99e, 0x08eeaac4, 0x08eea3d8. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

Initialises the generic title menu 0x08eea8f4 with the module heap (ui_title_init_menu) for the tab-select screen: item spacing 0x14 and 8 visible rows (0x08eeaa84/0x08eeaa86 and 0x08eea9a1/0x08eea9a2), clears 0x08eea9b0/0x08eea9b4, installs ui_title_draw_tab_select_tab as the draw callback of the three tabs (0x08eea914, 0x08eea938, 0x08eea95c; 0x24-byte tab records) and ui_title_draw_tab_select_items as the list item drawer (0x08eeaab4). No return value. Side effects: the menu record. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_tab_select).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_tab_select_tab(void *list, ushort tab, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Tab callback of the tab-select menu: clips to an 0x51-pixel-wide scissor at (x + 8, y + 4) 14 high for the current tab (byte 0x08eeac02) or (x + 8, y + 5) 10 high for the others, draws tab sprite 0x42 + tab of the 0x16-byte sprite table, and its label (title message 9 + tab, table 0) at (x + 0x16, y) with font scale 0xd in the tab record's active (0x08eea908 + 0x24 * tab) or inactive (0x08eea90c + 0x24 * tab) colour; then disables the scissor test. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE state, font state, the display list. No direct caller (callback stored by ui_title_init_tab_select_menu).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_tab_select_items(void *list, ushort item, int x, int y)
column3: Item callback of the tab-select list: draws the item background sprite 0x3d at (x + 1, y - 1) and the item's title message (table 0) at (x + 0x15, y + 1), width 0xda, fit to width, black, font scale 0xd; the message index is item + 0x1e for tab 0, + 0x3e for tab 1 and + 9 for tab 2 (tab byte 0x08eeac02). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: font state, the display list. No direct caller (callback stored by ui_title_init_tab_select_menu).

Clears the 0x1250-byte wireless lobby block at 0x08eead8c (entry count, room list, player entries, packet buffers). No return value. Side effects: writes the block. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_wireless_lobby, ui_title_update_wireless_menu).

Fills the 0x14-byte lobby list entries at 0x08eead90 (9 entries): with mode 4 converts the nine 0x6c-byte rooms reported by the network library (array at 0x08eeb370: +0x00 status, +0x04 host name, +0x3c value, +0x44-+0x48 rule bytes, +0x4a room text, +0x6a card id) into entry bit fields (+0 status bits 3-4, game kind bits 0-2, tag bits 5-6, match bit 7; +1 LP setting bits 1-4; +2 time nibble and bit 4), a value halfword +4, name pointers +0x0c/+0x10 and, for kind 1 (card trade), the offered card id +6 and its name (card_db_get_name) +8; counts the occupied rooms into 0x08eead8c (at least 5). Other modes fill the 9 entries with the names of characters 1-9 (world_get_character_name_string_first) and set the count to 9. Returns 1. Side effects: the lobby list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_poll_wireless_session).

Clears the nine 0x84-byte player entries at 0x08eeae44 (0x4a4 bytes), sets the entry count 0x08eead8c to 9 and, for each of the nine 100-byte member records of the network library's member list, stores pointers to the member's name (+0x14) and text (+0x46) at entry +0x00/+0x04 and copies its two state nibbles (+4 and +8) into entry byte +0x82. No return value. Side effects: the player entries. Callers: 1 (ui_title_poll_wireless_session).
Clears the 0x1608-byte communication-rules work area work (system_memset). No return value. Side effects: writes the area. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_comm_rules).

Enters the ad-hoc wireless state 0xf: clears 0x08eec1c0, the third level and step, stores state and sub_state (forced to 1 when bits 1-2 of 0x08eea3fa equal 2, i.e. re-entering after a duel, hypothesis medium), sets all pending words to 0xfff, the timer to 0, 0x08eeac70 = 0, 0x08eeac72 = 2 and both title colours white; initialises the menu 0x08eea8f4 for the lobby (geometry 4,0x34 / 0x131 x 0x2a, spacing 0x14, 5 rows, cursor frame callback ui_title_draw_wireless_cursor_frame), creates the duel set-up panel with the title_menu archive (ui_title_create_duel_setup_panel(heap, archive, 5)), clears the 0xa4-byte block 0x08eec05c and sets or clears global flag 4 (system_set_global_flags) by bits 1-2 of 0x08eea3fa. No return value. Side effects: title state, the menu, the panel, global flags. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Title state 0xf by sub-state 0x08eea3e0: from sub-state 3 to 0x16 first polls the session (ui_title_poll_wireless_session(0, 0)), setting bit 2 of 0x08eeda48 when it returns 0 (busy) and clearing it otherwise; when bit 2 is clear dispatches: 0 intro, 1-2 starts the network (system_net_init) and goes to 3, 4 wireless menu, 5 rules, 6-7 lobby, 8 single duel, 9 tag duel, 10-0xd empty stubs, 0xe card trade, 0xf card trade card select, 0x10-0x13 card gift, 0x14 waits for bit 5 of 0x08eeda48 (hides the overlay and marks the library flag) or goes to 0x16, 0x15 returns to 0x14, 0x16 tears down (overlay off, 0x08eeda19 = 0, frees the duel set-up panel, releases the card trade, closes the character list, unloads the library module, frees the external list, clears global flag 4 and bits 1-2 of 0x08eea3fa, calls the BOOT net helper 0x08850664(1), system_net_term) and requests the main menu (state 9, sub-state 8), sub-state 0x17. Copies the sub-state to 0x08eea3fe and advances the 30-step animation counter 0x08eec1c2. No return value. Side effects: network session, title state, the listed releases. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_state).

Drives the ad-hoc session from the network library's manager state (system_net_api_get_manager_state) and performs request: 8 changes the manager to state 0xb, 9 cancels the selected peer, 3 hosts a room with the rules from 0x08eebfdc-0x08eebfde and the room texts 0x08eebfe8/0x08eebfec, 4 joins room 0x08eea99f with the player name and limit-list name, 5 joins it tagged with arg, 6 toggles ignoring member arg, 7 drops unlisted peers, 2 asks for state 0x21. Per manager state: 0x1f (connected) runs ui_title_update_wireless_handshake; 0xb refreshes the room list (system_net_api_get_room_list into 0x08eeb36c, ui_title_fill_wireless_room_list(4)) and moves sub-state 3 to 4; 0x1e fetches the member list into 0x08eeb73c (ui_title_init_wireless_player_entries); 0x15 copies the selected room's rules into 0x08eebfdc-0x08eebfde (lobby sub-state 7) or the host slots; 8 picks the next sub-state from the rules (single duel 8, tag duel 9, trade 0xe); 0x23 and 0xe-0x11 (refused, full, left) open a tushin message box (0x08eea6b4) and set step 0x14; 0 terminates the network when leaving; -1 (error) sets the trade error flags, bit 7 of 0x08eead88 and moves to sub-state 0x14/0x15. A pending library error (system_net_api_has_error) also sets the trade error flag. Returns 1, 0 while the manager is in state 10, or the join_room_tagged result for request 5. Side effects: network requests, lobby block 0x08eead8c.., rules bytes, title step/sub-state, message box, sounds. Callers: 7 (ui_title_select_wireless_lobby_entry, ui_title_update_wireless, ui_title_poll_wireless_lobby_cursor, ui_card_trade_update, ...).

column2: ushort * ui_title_get_deck_source_name(short character, short kind, short value)
column3: Returns the display name of a duellist's deck choice: kind 0 (own decks) value 0 the current deck (deck_get_member_slot_name(0) into 0x08eec3b8), value n the name of stored deck n - 1 (save_get_stored_deck, name at +4 when its first word is non-zero); kind 1 (recipe) the recipe name for value < 0x1ce (462) or title message 0x5e otherwise; kind 2 (external deck) the name buffer 0x08eed6d4 for character 1 (the player) or 0x08eed7d4. Returns NULL for anything else. Side effects: may write 0x08eec3b8. Callers: 1 (ui_title_pack_wireless_entry).

Packs a 0x84-byte wireless player entry into its 0x3a-byte network form: +0x30/+0x32/+0x34 = entry character +0x7a, +0x7c and deck value +0x7e, +0x36-+0x39 = the nibble bytes +0x80-+0x83 (variant, team/deck kind, entry state, claimed slot), and the first 0x18 UTF-16 characters of the deck name (ui_title_get_deck_source_name(character, kind = high nibble of +0x81, value)) at +0. No return value. Side effects: writes packet. Callers: 1 (ui_title_send_wireless_entry).

column2: bool ui_title_send_wireless_deck(void *entry, char phase, char step)
column3: Sends a deck packet: clears the 0x200-byte packet buffer 0x08eebacc, type byte 3, byte 2 = step, byte 3 = phase; when entry is given builds that duellist's deck (ui_title_build_wireless_duel_setup into 0x08eec100) and copies the 0xc0-byte deck as payload; sends 0xc4 bytes (system_net_api_send_game_data) and on success sets the sync target (type, step, phase). Returns true when the send was accepted. Side effects: packet buffer, 0x08eec100, the duel set-up buffer (through the builder), network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_handshake).

Collects the deck packets (type 3) of all peers (system_net_api_get_peer_buffer): for phase 2 a packet with byte 3 = 2 stores its 0xc0-byte deck at 0x08eebcd4 + 0xc0 * peer; for phase 4 a packet with byte 3 = 3 stores it at slot (peer + 2) & 3 with two peers, or at 0x08eebf14 otherwise (the CPU partner's deck). Returns 1 when all expected decks arrived (every peer for 2 or 4 peers; with 3 peers 3 decks at handshake step 0x11 or 1 deck at step 0x14), else 0. Side effects: the received deck buffers. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_handshake).

Sends the local player's entry: packet type 2 (byte 2 = 1, byte 3 = 0) in 0x08eebacc with a 0x7a-byte payload holding the slot-claim table 0x08eebac8 (4 bytes, copied only by peer 0, the host), the local entry (0x08eeae44 + 0x84 * local index 0x08eead85, ui_title_pack_wireless_entry) and, when bit 4 of 0x08eead88 is set, the CPU partner entry (index = low nibble of 0x08eead88) or zeros; sends 0x7e bytes and on success sets the sync target. Callers pass 0 or 1 but the decompiled body reads no argument. Returns true when the send was accepted. Side effects: packet buffer, network traffic. Callers: 11 (ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input, ui_title_update_wireless_partner_pick, ui_title_receive_wireless_entries, ui_title_update_wireless_handshake, ...).

Inverse of ui_title_pack_wireless_entry: copies the character, second word and deck value (+0x30/+0x32/+0x34) to entry +0x7a/+0x7c/+0x7e, the four nibble bytes +0x36-+0x39 to +0x80-+0x83 and the 0x18-character deck name to entry +0x3a. No return value. Side effects: writes entry. Callers: 1 (ui_title_receive_wireless_entries).

Reads every peer's entry packet (type 2, byte 2 = 1): peer 0's claim table is copied to 0x08eebac8; each peer's own entry, when its state nibble is set and ui_title_check_wireless_slot_claim accepts it, is unpacked into 0x08eeae44 + 0x84 * peer and written to the duel set-up panel slot of its team (ui_title_get_wireless_peer_team, ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_full with character, variant, kind and the entry's name and deck strings); a second entry (CPU partner) goes to slot (peer + 2) & 3 with two peers or to the CPU partner entry otherwise, likewise shown in the panel. Afterwards the host re-sends its entry when the claim table changed (0x08eebac4) and more than two peers are present. No return value. Side effects: player entries, claim table, the set-up panel, 0x08eebac4, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_entry_sync).

Arbitrates a tag-duel slot claim carried in an entry packet (claim kind = low nibble of +0x38: 1-2 claim, 3 release; slot = low nibble of +0x39; claim table 0x08eebac8: low nibble kind, high nibble owning peer). With fewer than three peers always 1. On the host (local index 0) a claim of a free slot is granted (table written, 0x08eebac4 = 1 to re-broadcast) and a claim by the current owner accepted; a release by the owner clears the slot (0x08eebac4 = 1). On a client a claim is accepted when the slot is free, or owned by peer and either peer is not the local player or the local entry's state matches. Returns 1 when accepted, else 0. The first argument is not used in the decompiled body. Side effects: the claim table, 0x08eebac4 (host only). Callers: 1 (ui_title_receive_wireless_entries).

With more than two peers and the local entry in claim state 1 (byte +0x82 of the local 0x84-byte entry), looks up its requested slot (+0x83) in the claim table 0x08eebac8: returns 1 when still free (pending), 2 when owned by the local peer, 0 when owned by someone else. Returns 2 in every other case. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_entry_sync).

Connection handshake of an ad-hoc duel or trade, by step byte 0x08eead89 (local peer index stored in 0x08eead85, peer count in 0x08eead8c): 0 clears the claim table and sends the player name (packet type 1, 0x14 bytes); 1 when synced collects the peer names and acknowledges; 2 by the rules byte 0x08eebfdc goes to 3 (single duel), 4 (tag duel) or, for a trade, sends type 1 step 6 and goes to 7; 3 marks the local entry state 1 and sends the entry; 4-6 entry exchange (ui_title_update_wireless_entry_sync); 7-10 card trade link (ui_card_trade_update_link); 0xc-0xe wait until the teams are ready (playing layout 0xc frames 0-0xe in tag mode at 0xe) and announce it; 0xf waits for sync; 0x10-0x11 exchange the own decks (deck phase 2); 0x12 waits and finishes (step 0x21) or, for a tag duel with at most three peers, exchanges the CPU partner's deck (0x13-0x15, phases 3/4); 0x16 sends the final packet (phase 5) and 0x17 finishes at step 0x21. Callers pass (request, arg) but the decompiled body reads no argument. Returns 0. Side effects: packet buffer 0x08eebacc, entries, claim table, network traffic, layout 0xc. Callers: 1 (ui_title_poll_wireless_session).

column2: bool ui_title_send_wireless_packet(char *packet, int clear, char type, char step, char phase, int payload_size)
column3: Sends a small packet: optionally clears the 0x200-byte packet (clear != 0), sets byte 0 = type, byte 2 = step, byte 3 = phase, sends payload_size + 4 bytes (system_net_api_send_game_data) and on success sets the sync target (type, step, phase). Returns true when the send was accepted. Side effects: packet, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_handshake).

Entry-exchange part of the handshake: receives entries (ui_title_receive_wireless_entries), then by the step 0x08eea3e4: 0xf (re)sends the entry and goes to 0x11; 0x11 checks the slot claim (ui_title_get_wireless_claim_state): granted returns to step 0xb and maps the third level 0x08eea3e8 (7 -> 2, 6 -> 5, 4 -> 0, 1/3 -> 2; 1 and 4 restore 0x08eeac74 from 0x08eeac78), refused plays 0x7a07, releases the claim (ui_title_claim_wireless_tag_slot(1)), re-sends and sets the third level 4 after saving 0x08eeac74 in 0x08eeac78; 0x13 sends and returns to 0xb; 0x16 sends and goes to 0x17; 0x17 checks ui_title_check_wireless_teams_ready: 1 shows tushin message 0x42 in the box 0x08eea6b4 and sets handshake step 5, 2 sets handshake step 0xe and step 0x19; 0x18 assigns a CPU partner (ui_title_assign_wireless_cpu_partner), claims a slot and sends (third level 3). No return value. Side effects: title step and level words, 0x08eeac74/0x08eeac78, entries, network traffic, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_handshake).

Builds the deck a wireless player sends: fills the duel set-up buffer (deck_get_duel_setup_buffer) with mode 1, single, +0x195 = 2, LP setting from bits 1-4 of 0x08eebfdd (ui_title_map_rule_to_duel_setting), +0x197 from 0x08eebfde, BGM set 1, random seed and first player; writes duellist record 0 from the entry (character +0x7a, variant from +0x80, second pair +0x7c / high nibble of +0x80) with the recipe code: non-player characters their recipe (< 462) or 466, the player by deck kind (high nibble of +0x81): 1 recipe, 0 current deck 465 or stored deck 463 with value - 1, 2/3 external; loads the decks (duel_setup_load_decks) and copies record 0's deck (+0x230) into out_deck (ui_title_copy_deck_cards), or for an external deck the buffer 0x08eed614 (player) / 0x08eed714. No return value. Side effects: the set-up buffer, deck loading, out_deck. Callers: 1 (ui_title_send_wireless_deck).

Copies a 0xc0-byte in-memory deck (deck.md): the three counts +0x00-+0x08, the 60 main ids +0x0c, 15 side ids +0x84 and 15 extra ids +0xa2. Returns dst. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 3 (ui_title_apply_selected_deck, ui_title_build_wireless_duel_setup, ui_title_apply_wireless_selected_deck).

Builds the duel set-up for an ad-hoc wireless duel and starts it (title state 0x26): clears the duellist characters, +0x195 = 2, mode 1, single or tag (+0x192, 2 or 4 duellists) from bits 5-6 of 0x08eebfdc, match +0x191 from bit 7, LP setting and +0x197 from 0x08eebfdd/0x08eebfde, BGM set 1, and a fixed seed +0x188 = 0x7b with first player +0x18c = 0, so every peer builds the same duel. With two peers each entry's slot (low nibble of +0x83) is adjusted for odd indices. For each set-up record finds the entry assigned to it, copies the received deck (0x08eebcd4 + 0xc0 * entry) to record +0x8c, the ruby-stripped name to +0x18 (the player's own name, or the character's name via world_call_get_character_name_string), the deck name to +0x4a (recipe name, title message 0x5e or the entry's name), recipe code 462 (keep), the team at +0x0c (index parity with two peers, else entry +0x81) and the variant. The local player's record becomes character 1 (or 0x2e) and other players' records character 0; for the local player the set-up's first 0xc0 bytes get the current deck (deck_copy_member_slot_cards) with 0xc6 bytes of save state +0x162bc, or the chosen deck with 99 halfwords of 4, and cards exceeding the owned counts are flagged (deck_flag_cards_exceeding_owned). Switches to scene 6. No return value. Side effects: the set-up buffer, entries, scene switch. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Clears the nine 0x84-byte player entries at 0x08eeae44 and, for each connected peer, copies the 0x10-character name from its packet buffer (+4) to entry +0x08 and points entry +0x00 at it. Called with the packet buffer but reads no argument. No return value. Side effects: the player entries. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_handshake).

Counts the player entries (0x84-byte records at 0x08eeae44) whose state nibble (+0x82) is 2 (ready) among the first 2 (single duel) or 4 (tag duel, bits 5-6 of 0x08eebfdc) entries. With three peers all ready at handshake step 4, finds the one tag slot (0-3, entry +0x83) nobody holds and, when it is the local player's partner slot ((own slot + 2) & 3), sets the CPU-partner index nibble of 0x08eead88 to 3 and returns 1 (the local player must supply a CPU partner). Returns 2 when the required number of entries are ready, else 0. Callers pass the packet buffer but the decompiled body reads no argument. Side effects: may write 0x08eead88. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_wireless_handshake, ui_title_update_wireless_entry_sync).

Returns the duel set-up panel slot used to show peer: in the single-duel screen (sub-state 8) 0 for the local peer and 1 for the other; otherwise, with up to two peers, the peer's slot nibble (+0x83 of its 0x84-byte entry) for the local peer or its partner position ((peer + 2) & 3 == local), else that nibble + 1; with three or more peers the slot nibble itself. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_title_receive_wireless_entries).

Draws the current wireless screen by sub-state 0x08eea3e0: 0 intro, 4 menu, 5 rules, 6-7 lobby, 8 single duel, 9 tag duel, 0xe card trade (ui_card_trade_draw), 0x10-0x13 card gift. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless).

Initialises the wireless top menu: clears the 0x14-byte rules record 0x08eebfdc, the step, third level and timer, sets the pending step/level to 0xfff, 0x08eeac70 = 0, 0x08eeac72 = 1, both colours white; sets up the room list menu 0x08eea8f4 (ui_title_init_wireless_list) with flag bits 2 and 6 of 0x08eeaa80 and the stub cursor callback, prepares tushin message 4 in the box 0x08eea6b4, sets the background layout slot 0x08eec1c8 = 7 and binds layouts 7 and 10 (frames 0..0x1e0) and the menu bar 0xf (0..0x11). No return value. Side effects: the listed globals, the menu, the message box, layouts. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_menu).

Initialises a generic title menu (ui_title_init_menu with the module heap) as the wireless room list: page geometry at +0x11c/+0x11e (2, 0x38), item size 0x1c9 x 0x28 (+0x130/+0x132), colour +0x134 = 0xffffff, 9 items (+0x190) with 5 visible (+0x192, copied to +0xad/+0xae), cursor frame callback ui_title_draw_wireless_cursor_frame at +0x1d0, cursor frame 0x1c9 x 0x29 and 0x1cd x 0x2c, clears several offsets and sets flag bit 6 of +0x18c and +0x30f = 1. No return value. Side effects: writes the menu. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_wireless_menu, ui_title_init_wireless_menu).

Opens a communication (tushin_msg) message box: title message-box defaults (ui_title_init_message_box), margins 10/8, font 0xc, position (0x3c, 100), size 0x168 x 0x50, text = tushin_msg string index (ui_title_get_message(index, 12)) at +0x84, a single OK button (nibbles of +0xca/+0xd3 = 1, +0xd4 = 1, flag bit 2 of +0xc8); re-opens it. No return value. Side effects: the window. Callers: 7 (ui_title_update_wireless_card_gift, ui_title_update_wireless_menu, ui_title_init_wireless_lobby, ui_title_poll_wireless_session, ...).

Wireless sub-state 4 (room list) by step 0x08eea3e4: 0-1 initialise the menu and clear the lobby, fade in (step 2); 2-3 wait for the fade; 4-5 play the menu-bar layout 0xf; 0xb handles input (ui_title_handle_wireless_menu_input): 9 (host) goes to the rules (pending sub-state 5), -2 leaves (step 0x1c, clearing bits 1-2 of 0x08eea3fa and global flag 4), -1 copies the hovered room's record into the rules 0x08eebfdc (ui_title_copy_wireless_record), a room index joins it by its game kind: 3/4 -> card gift (sub-state 0x10), 1 -> card gift request with the room's card 0x08eec1c4 (flag 0x08eec1c6 bit 0 set when save_test_card_flag_bit7 is clear; request 5 with that card), 0/2 -> lobby (sub-state 7, join request 4); 0xc waits up to 90 frames for the connection and then shows tushin message 4 (2 for a gift) as a timeout (step 0x15); 0x14/0x15 wait for the message box 0x08eea6b4 to close (0x15 also cancels the peer) and rebuild the list keeping the cursor; 0x1c/0x1e request the next sub-state with a fade (0x1c returns to the main menu via step 0x20, which asks the network to leave). No return value. Side effects: title state, rules record, network requests, message box, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).

Copies a 0x14-byte wireless room record (four halfwords and three words: rule bit fields, value, card id and name pointers) from src to dst. Returns dst. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_menu).

Draws the wireless room list: background layout 0x08eec1c8, the menu bar and its label from step 5, the top window with ui_title_draw_wireless_top_caption, the list window (ui_title_draw_wireless_list_window(list, 5, 8)), the scrolling room list, the menu 0x08eea8f4 from step 7 (cursor callback reset to ui_title_draw_wireless_cursor_frame) and the message box 0x08eea6b4 at steps 0x14/0x15. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, 0x08eeaac4. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_substate).

Initialises the host's rule-setting screen: step 0, rule row 0x08eea3e8 = 1, game kind bits of 0x08eebfdc cleared, colours white; sets up the message box 0x08eea594 as the rule list (position 4,0x5b, size 0x1d9 x 0x78, item geometry, choice drawer ui_title_draw_wireless_rule_choice at +0xfc, stub at +0x10c); local peer index 0x08eead85 = 0, room host name 0x08eebfe8 = the player name, bit 4 of 0x08eebfdc set, room text 0x08eebfec = the limit-list name (deck_get_limit_list_name); binds layouts 8 (0..0x1e0) and 0xf (0..0x11). No return value. Side effects: the listed globals, the window, layouts. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_rules).

Wireless sub-state 5 by step: 0-1 initialise (ui_title_init_wireless_rules) and fade in, 2-3 wait for the fade, 4-5 play the menu bar, 0xb handles input (ui_title_handle_wireless_rules_input) and sets the number of choices of the current rule row (+0xcc of the window: row 0 -> 1, 1 -> 3, 2/3 -> 2, 4/5 -> 5, 6 -> 4 for a duel or 1), 0x1c returns to the room list (sub-state 4), 0x1e requests the pending sub-state and hosts the room (ui_title_poll_wireless_session(3, 0)), 0x1f/0x20 wait for the fade. No return value. Side effects: title state, the window, network request. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).

Input of the rule screen: updates the list window 0x08eea594 and edits the rules bytes by the current row 0x08eea3e8: 0 game kind (bits 0-2 of 0x08eebfdc; kind 0 goes to row 1, kinds 1-3 straight to the confirm row 6), 1 single/tag (bits 5-6; choice 2 forces kind 2 and tag 2 and goes to row 6), 2 match flag (bit 7), 3 custom LP flag (bit 0 of 0x08eebfdd; off sets LP code 2 and time 0 and jumps to row 6), 4 LP setting (bits 1-4 of 0x08eebfdd), 5 time (low nibble of 0x08eebfde), 6 confirm: sets step 0x1e with pending sub-state 0x10 for kinds 1, 3, 4 or 6 (lobby) for kinds 0 and 2; rows 7-9 also go to the lobby. Cancel steps back a row (skipping rows that do not apply) and pre-selects the stored value, or leaves (step 0x1c) from rows 0-1. Stops sound 0x7a04 on row 6. No return value. Side effects: rules bytes 0x08eebfdc-0x08eebfde, the window, title step. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_rules).

Draws the rule screen: layout 8, the menu bar from step 5, the top window, the list window (1, 4), the bottom message window with the help index (ui_title_get_wireless_help_index, table 0xc), the rule list window 0x08eea594, the row help (ui_title_draw_wireless_rules_help) for rows below 7, the bottom window (caption 0xd on the confirm row, else 0xc) and, on the confirm row, a pulsing cursor frame at (0x62, 0xf8) size 0x11b x 0x15. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_substate).

Draws the help line of the current rule row in a tushin message window at (8, 0x5f), width 0x1d0, height 0xf: message 0x55 for row 0, 0x54 + row for rows 1-5, 0x9c for the confirm row 6, none for 7-8 (ui_title_draw_tushin_message_window). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_rules).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_rule_choice(void *list, ushort item, int x, int y)
column3: Choice callback of the rule list: picks the tushin message of choice item for the current row (row 0: 0x5b + item, 1: 0x5f +, 2: 99 +, 3: 0x65 +, 4: 0x67 +, 5: 0x97 +; on the confirm row the summary of each setting: time 0x97 + value, LP 0x67 + value, match 99 or 100, single/tag from the table 0x08ee4bb0) and draws it at (x, y), width 0x100, scale 0xf, colour 0xff002020 (ui_title_draw_message_styled, table 12). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. No direct caller (callback stored by ui_title_init_wireless_rules).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_rules_summary(void *list, short row, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Draws one line of a room's rule summary (tushin table 12, fit to width, scale 0xd, colour 0xff002020): for a duel room row 0 single/tag (0x5f + value), 1 match (0x48 or 0x49), 2 LP (0x4b + value), 3 time (0x50 + value); for game kind 1 message 0x29; other kinds 0x5a + kind. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Initialises the lobby screen (sub-states 6 host / 7 guest): clears step, third level and timer, colours white; sets up the list window 0x08eeac3c as an 8-entry grid (position 4,0x5b, size 0x1d9 x 0x78, cell 0xe7 x 0x16 at 8,0x6f, two columns, entry drawer ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby_entry), opens the bottom message box 0x08eea594 with the help index (table 0xc) and prepares tushin message 4 in 0x08eea6b4; a guest (sub-state != 6) reads the selected room into 0x08eebff0 and points the host name 0x08eebfe8 at it; local peer index 0x08eead85 = 0 for the host, 1 for a guest; binds the menu bar 0xf. No return value. Side effects: the listed globals and windows. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_lobby).

Lobby sub-states 6-7 by step: 0-1 initialise and clear the lobby block, fade in; 2-3 wait; 4-5 play the menu bar; 0xb handles input (ui_title_handle_wireless_lobby_input); 0x14 waits for the message box 0x08eea6b4 (then step 0x16); 0x1c returns to sub-state 3 (reconnect); 0x1e requests the pending sub-state; 0x1d waits for the handshake; 0x1f/0x20 wait for the fade. No return value. Side effects: title state, windows. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).

Lobby input: polls the cursor (ui_title_poll_wireless_lobby_cursor); an entry index 0-7 toggles that player (ui_title_select_wireless_lobby_entry); 9 (start) when accepted sets step 0x1d and the pending sub-state from the rules: duel -> 8 single or 9 tag (resetting the external list flags), trade -> 0xe (clearing the trade offer list); -2 leaves (step 0x1c). No return value. Side effects: title step, pending sub-state, network requests. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_lobby).

Host lobby action: counts the selected players (state nibble of +0x82 set in the first 8 entries) against the maximum (1 guest for a single duel or trade, 3 for a tag duel); for entry < 9, when below the maximum and the entry is occupied, plays 0x7a05 and asks the network to toggle the member (request 6) and returns 1, else plays 0x7a07; for entry 9 (start) with at least one player plays 0x7a05, drops the unselected peers (request 7), stores the count in 0x08eead8c and returns 1, else 0x7a07. Returns 0 when refused. Side effects: network requests, 0x08eead8c, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_handle_wireless_lobby_input).

Moves the host lobby cursor 0x08eeac57 over the two-column grid of 0x08eeac59 entries (Up/Down within a column, Left/Right across columns, Down from the last row or Up from the first moves to the start button, flag 0x08eeac70), clamps the shown cursor 0x08eeac58, and reads the confirm/cancel buttons (system_get_confirm_button): confirm on the start button returns 9, on an empty but occupied entry returns its index, on a selected entry plays 0x7a06 and deselects it (request 6); cancel returns -2. Guests (sub-state 7) can only cancel, and only while the manager state is 0x15 (request 2). Returns -1 otherwise. Side effects: cursor bytes, sounds, network requests. Callers: 1 (ui_title_handle_wireless_lobby_input).

Draws the lobby: layout 8 (host) or 7 (guest), the menu bar from step 5, top window, list window (1, 4), the bottom message box 0x08eea594; for the host (sub-state 6) the player grid 0x08eeac3c with its caption and, at step 0xb, the entry cursor; the bottom window (caption 0xd once a player is selected, else 0xc); the pulsing start-button frame when the cursor is on it; and the message box 0x08eea6b4 at step 0x14. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_substate).

Draws a pulsing frame around the grid cell of the shown cursor 0x08eeac58 of the list window 0x08eeac3c (cell 0x08eeac62 x 0x08eeac64 plus gaps 0x08eeac46/0x08eeac48 from origin 0x08eeac5e/0x08eeac60, column count from 0x08eeac5a / 0x08eeac5b), 2 pixels larger on each side, colour 0x08eeac4c (ui_title_draw_pulsing_cursor_frame). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby).

Draws the lobby caption in a tushin message window at (8, 0x5e), 0x1d0 x 0xf: message 0x96 for a trade, 0x95 for a tag duel, 0x94 otherwise. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby_entry(void *list, ushort entry, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Item callback of the lobby grid: draws the entry frame (bright when the entry is occupied, ui_title_draw_wireless_entry_frame), menu icons 0 and 0xb, the entry label (tushin message 0x17 + entry, scale 0xc), the player's name (entry +0x00, fit to 0x60 pixels, colour 0xff004040) and text (+0x04, 0x36 pixels, white), and icon 0xe when the entry is selected (state nibble of +0x82). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: font state, the display list. No direct caller (callback stored by ui_title_init_wireless_lobby).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_entry_frame(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, int lit)
column3: Draws sprite record 0x4a of the 0x16-byte sprite table (copied from 0x08ee53b6) at (x, y) as a lobby entry frame, opaque white when lit, else 0xa0ffffff (translucent). width and height are passed but the record's own size is used. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby_entry).

Resets the single-duel set-up screen: clears step, third level and timer, 0x08eeac70 = 0, 0x08eeac72 = 2, the cursor 0x08eeac74 = 0, the number of rows 0x08eeac7c = 2, copies the local index 0x08eead85 to 0x08eead84 and stores keep_layouts in bit 5 of 0x08eead88; when keep_layouts is 0 binds layouts 0xb (0..0x1df), 0xd (0..0) and 0xf (0..0x11). No return value. Side effects: the listed globals, layouts. Callers: 3 (ui_title_update_wireless_deck_select, ui_title_update_wireless_character_select, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

Resets the four slots of the duel set-up panel (ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_full(i, 0, i, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, i): no character, kind 3 = empty) and sets the panel mode (ui_title_set_duel_setup_mode(mode)). No return value. Side effects: the set-up panel. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

Wireless sub-state 8 (single duel set-up) by step 0x08eea3e4: 1 loads the character list module (ui_title_load_wireless_charalist), 2 resets the screen and the panel slots (mode 5) and fades in, 3 waits, 4-5 play the menu bar 0xf and the panel layout 0xd, 6 waits for handshake step 4 and starts the set-up timer (1, 10), 7 runs the panel until it reports 1, 8-9 re-enter after a sub-screen (layouts, fade); 0xb handles input (ui_title_call_handle_comm_single_duel_input): 1 marks the entry ready and sends it (step 0x17, or 0x16 to retry), 0 opens the deck choice (cursor 0x08eeac74 0: external decks via step 0x23, else character select 0x25) with 0x08eec38e = cursor; steps 0x23-0x25 run the external-deck load, deck select and character select; 0x1c returns to the main menu, 0x1e requests the pending step. When the handshake reaches step 0x21 requests state 0x26 (start the wireless duel). No return value. Side effects: title state, the panel, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).

Fills the local player's 0x84-byte entry (index 0x08eead85) for a single duel: slot nibble 0, character 1 (+0x7a and +0x7c), variant 0 with the local index in the high nibble of +0x80, deck kind 0 / value 0 (current deck), state 1, peer nibble = local index; shows it in the set-up panel (ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_full with the entry's name pointer) and sets the other peer's ((index + 1) & 1) slot nibble to 1. No return value. Side effects: the entries, the set-up panel. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_handshake).

Calls ui_title_handle_comm_single_duel_input(0) (the wireless variant of the single-duel set-up input) and returns its result (passed through in v0; the decompiler shows no return value, the caller tests it for 0 and 1).
