Side effects: those of the callee. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

Draws the single-duel set-up screen: below step 0x23 layout 0xb, the menu bar, the panel layout 0xd (playing sound 0x7a81 at frame 0x17 and 0x7a82 at frame 0x4b), from step 0xb the top/bottom windows, from step 7 the set-up panel (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel), a pulsing frame on the cursor row (rectangles from the table 0x08ee4bbc) and a ready mark (sprite from 0x08ee4c1c/0x08ee4c20 placed by the tables 0x08ee4bec/0x08ee4bfc) for each of the two entries in state 2. Step 0x23 draws the import progress message (save_import_update_message), 0x24 the deck list, 0x25 the character grid. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_substate).

Resets the tag-duel set-up screen: clears step, third level and timer, 0x08eeac70 = 0, 0x08eeac72 = 2, copies the local index to 0x08eead84; with two peers the cursor 0x08eeac74 = 0 and 0x08eead88 = CPU partner at slot (local + 2) & 3 with bit 4 set (each player brings a CPU partner), otherwise the cursor = local index and the partner nibble 3; 4 rows (0x08eeac7c); binds layouts 0xf, 0xd, 0xb (0..0x1df) and 0xc. No return value. Side effects: the listed globals, layouts. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel).

Reads the character chosen in the character-list module: since ui_title_stub_return_1_wireless always returns 1, it calls the list's refresh with the module heap (thunk_ui_charalist_e11636ec) and stores the selected character and variant (ui_charalist_get_selected_character/_variant), the character's default deck (ui_title_get_character_default_deck) and whether the character is neither the player nor character 0x2e (out_is_npc = 1). The dead fallback would return character 2, variant 0. Each output is optional (NULL skipped). No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 5 (ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input, ui_title_update_wireless_tag_slots, ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_2p, ui_title_init_wireless_tag_slots, ...).

Fills the local player's entry for a tag duel (character 1, variant 0, deck value 0, slot nibble 0, local index in +0x80, current-deck name from deck_get_member_slot_name(0) copied to +0x3a) and, with at most two peers and a local index below 2, the CPU partner entry at index local + 2 from the character-list choice (ui_title_get_charalist_choice): character, variant, default deck, slot 2 and deck kind 1 for an NPC or the current-deck name for the player. No return value. Side effects: the entries, 0x08eec3b8. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel).

Fills the CPU partner entry (index = low nibble of 0x08eead88) from the character-list choice: character, variant and default deck, deck kind 1 for an NPC or the current-deck name for the player character, state cleared and slot = (own slot + 2) & 3; then sets the cursor 0x08eeac74 (and 0x08eeac78) to 1 when the own slot is 2-3 or 4 when it is 0-1. No return value. Side effects: the entries, 0x08eeac74/0x08eeac78. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_entry_sync).

Wireless sub-state 9 (tag duel set-up) by step 0x08eea3e4: 1 loads the character list module, 2 resets the screen (ui_title_init_wireless_tag_duel) and the panel slots (mode 6) and fades in, 3 waits, 4-5 play the menu bar 0xf and the panel layout 0xd (frames 100-0x81, then 0x82-0x9f), 6 waits for handshake step 4, fills the tag slots once (ui_title_init_wireless_tag_slots, bit 5 of 0x08eead88) and starts the set-up timer (1, 10), 7 runs the panel, 8-9 return from a sub-screen, 0xb handles the slot screen (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_slots), 0x19/0x1a hold layout 0xc at frame 0xe and, when the handshake reaches step 0x21, free the external list, unload the library module and request state 0x26 (start the duel); 0x1c returns to the main menu, 0x1e requests the pending step; 0x23-0x26 run the external-deck load, deck select, character select and partner pick. No return value. Side effects: title state, the panel, layouts, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).

Step 0x23 of the wireless set-up: loads the decks stored on the memory stick for the slot being edited (0x08eead84) when it belongs to the player (character 1 or 0x2e): third level 0 frees the external list and starts an import with the module heap (save_import_begin), 1 scans (save_import_update_scan(1, &count 0x08eec3b0)) and allocates count * 0x1c0 bytes for the list 0x08eec3a4 (flags 0x08eec3ac = 3), 2 loads the records (save_import_update_load, loaded count 0x08eec3b4 capped at 0x100, flags 4). When done (or for a non-player slot, or no decks) fades, sets step 0x24 and enters the deck select (ui_title_enter_wireless_deck_select). Calls the BOOT net helper 0x08850664 with 0 before and 1 after. No return value. Side effects: heap, the external deck list, save import tasks, fades, title step. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

Step 0xb of the tag set-up: while no partner choice animation runs (0x08eede60 == 0) dispatches the input by session shape: two peers -> ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_2p; handshake step 5 waits for the message box 0x08eea6b4 and then sets handshake step 6 and step 0x18; step 4 -> ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_team; otherwise ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input. While the animation runs it shows the character-list choice in the CPU partner's panel slot (ui_title_get_charalist_choice, ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_full) for 60 frames with sound 0x7a04, then writes it into the edited entry (ui_title_set_wireless_entry_fields, state 2, slot claim 1), plays 0x7a05 and sends the entry (step 0xb, or 0x13 to retry). No return value. Side effects: entries, the panel, sounds, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel).

Tag set-up input when only two consoles are connected (each brings a CPU partner): at third level 0 Left/Right switch the team cursor 0x08eeac74 between the halves and confirm claims the slot (ui_title_claim_wireless_tag_slot(0), sound 0x7a05) and sends the entry (step 0x11/0xf, third level 1, return value 0x08eeac78 = 2 or 5); at level 2 the cursor moves over the six cells (own and partner rows, the start button flag 0x08eeac70) with Up/Down/Left/Right depending on which side the player is on; Square (0x8000) on the partner cell starts the partner choice animation (0x08eede60 = 1); confirm on a cell opens its action (ui_title_open_wireless_slot_action: 1 deck, 2 character, 3 partner pick, 4 partner deck; selects 0x08eead84) or, on the start button, marks the entries ready and sends (step 0x17/0x16); cancel releases the slot (ui_title_claim_wireless_tag_slot(1)), sends and sets level 4. No return value. Side effects: cursor and step globals, entries, sounds, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_slots).

Claims (release 0) or releases (release 1) a tag-duel slot for the local entry: with fewer than three peers or a handshake beyond step 5 the CPU partner is enabled (bit 4 of 0x08eead88). Before handshake step 5: a claim takes slot = cursor 0x08eeac74 (0-3) unless the claim table 0x08eebac8 already has it (returns 0), writes the local entry with state 1 and claim flag 1 (ui_title_set_wireless_entry_fields) and the CPU partner entry at the opposite slot (slot + 2) & 3; a release writes state 3 and clears the partner entry. From step 5 on only a claim of the partner's slot is possible (when free). Returns 1 on success, 0 when the slot is taken or for a late release. Side effects: entries, 0x08eead88. Callers: 3 (ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_2p, ui_title_update_wireless_entry_sync, ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_team).

Sets the local entry's state nibble (+0x82) to 2 (ready) and, for a tag duel with two peers, or at handshake step 6 with three peers, also the CPU partner entry (index = low nibble of 0x08eead88). No return value. Side effects: entries. Callers: 4 (ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_2p, ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input, ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_team, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

column2: void ui_title_set_wireless_entry_fields(void *entry, uchar peer, uchar slot, short character, uchar variant, short character2, char variant2, char deck_kind, short deck_value, char claim, uchar state)
column3: Writes the fields of a 0x84-byte wireless player entry: low nibble of +0x81 = peer, low nibble of +0x83 = slot and high nibble = claim, +0x7a = character, low nibble of +0x80 = variant, +0x7c = character2, high nibble of +0x80 = variant2, high nibble of +0x81 = deck kind (0 own deck, 1 recipe, 2 external), +0x7e = deck value, low nibble of +0x82 = state (0 empty, 1 joined, 2 ready, 3 released). Arguments 9-11 are passed on the stack. No return value. Side effects: writes entry. Callers: 4 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_slots, ui_title_apply_wireless_selected_deck, ui_title_claim_wireless_tag_slot, ui_title_apply_wireless_partner_pick).

Opens the sub-screen chosen on a tag set-up cell, remembering the cursor in 0x08eec38e and playing 0x7a05: 1 and 4 the deck choice (pending step 0x23, external decks first), 2 the character select (step 0x25), 3 the partner pick (step 0x26, through ui_title_request_state_with_steps); each requests a fade-out and sets step 0x1f. Actions 3 and 4 check ui_title_stub_return_1_wireless (always 1). No return value. Side effects: 0x08eec38e, the fade and pending step, title step, sounds. Callers: 3 (ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_2p, ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input, ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_team).

Tag set-up input for the handshake team phase (step 4, three or four consoles): at third level 0 the d-pad moves the slot cursor 0x08eeac74 in a 2 x 2 grid, confirm claims the slot (ui_title_claim_wireless_tag_slot(0); 0x7a07 when taken) and sends the entry (level 1), cancel plays 0x7a07; at level 2 the cursor moves over the six cells and the start button, confirm opens the cell's action (ui_title_open_wireless_slot_action with 1-4 depending on the player's side, selecting the edited entry 0x08eead84) or marks ready and sends, cancel releases the slot, sends, stores the slot in 0x08eeac78 (ui_title_clamp_tag_slot_index) and sets level 4. No return value. Side effects: cursor/step globals, entries, sounds, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_slots).

Tag set-up input for the remaining handshake phases: Up/Down move the cursor 0x08eeac74 between the rows of the six cells and the start button (0x08eeac70), Square on a partner cell (1 or 4) starts the partner choice animation (0x08eede60 = 1) after reading the character-list choice; confirm opens the cell's action (ui_title_open_wireless_slot_action, with the edited entry 0x08eead84 set to the local or CPU partner entry by the partner's slot) or, on the start button, marks ready and sends (step 0x17/0x16). No return value. Side effects: cursor/step globals, entries, sounds, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_slots).
Returns slot when it is 0-3, otherwise 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_title_handle_wireless_tag_input_team).
Returns cursor when it is 0-3, otherwise 0 (same as ui_title_clamp_tag_slot_index, written as a switch). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_title_claim_wireless_tag_slot).

Prepares the deck list for the edited wireless entry 0x08eead84: clears the deck lists, third level and timer, cursor 0x08eeac74 = 0, one row, 0x08eeac80 = 0, 0x08eeac81 = 6, stores the entry index in 0x08eec38f, reads its set-up panel slot (ui_title_get_duel_setup_slot) and keeps the character in 0x08eec394; for the player (1 or 0x2e) the tab count 0x08eeac72 is 3 with first tab 2 (external decks) when the import flags 0x08eec3ac report state 2, else 2 tabs from tab 0; for other characters tab 5 (recipes) only; shows the tab on layout 4 and builds the list (ui_title_build_deck_list(character)). No return value. Side effects: the listed globals, deck lists, layout 4. Callers: 1 (ui_title_load_wireless_external_decks).

Deck-select sub-screen of the wireless set-up (step 0x24) by third level 0x08eea3e8: 0 fades in with pending level 2; 2 handles input (ui_title_handle_wireless_deck_select_input); 3 (cancel) fades out with pending level 8, 4 (chosen) with pending level 6; 6 copies the staged deck value (0x08eeb366) and deck kind (high nibble of 0x08eeb369) of the staging entry 0x08eeb2e8 into the edited entry 0x08eead84 and sends it (level 7); 7-8 return to the set-up screen: single duel (sub-state 8) re-initialises it keeping the layouts, a tag duel restores the cursor from 0x08eec38e at level 2; fades in and sets step 8. No return value. Side effects: entries, title levels, fades, network traffic. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

Runs the shared deck-list input (ui_title_handle_deck_select_input(character 0x08eec394, &kind 0x08eec39c, &index 0x08eec3a0)): -2 sets the third level to 3 (cancel); a choice sets the cursor blink mode 1, stages it (ui_title_apply_wireless_selected_deck) and sets level 4. No return value. Side effects: 0x08eea3e8, the staging entry. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_deck_select).

Stages the deck chosen for the edited entry 0x08eead84: for an external deck (kind 2) copies the 0x40-byte name and the deck (+0x100 of the 0x1c0-byte record index 0x08eec3a0 of the list 0x08eec3a4) into the external buffers 0x08eed6d4/0x08eed614 (player) or +0x100 (other character); then writes the staging entry 0x08eeb2e8 with the edited entry's slot, character and variants, deck kind 0x08eec39c, deck value 0x08eec3a0, claim 2, state 1. No return value. Side effects: external deck buffers, the staging entry. Callers: 1 (ui_title_handle_wireless_deck_select_input).

Draws the tag-duel set-up screen from step 2: below step 0x23 layout 0xb, the menu bar, the panel layout 0xd (sounds 0x7a81 at frame 0x7b and 0x7a82 at 0xaf), from step 0xb the top/bottom windows (caption 0xd from level 2) and the set-up info (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info(list, 2)), from step 7 the panel, layout 0xc once the handshake passed step 0xd in tag mode; publishes the local cursor (bits 0-2 of lobby entry +0) and third level (high nibble of +2) in the local 0x14-byte lobby record; draws the cursor (ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_cursor), the ready marks and, at handshake step 5, the message box 0x08eea6b4. Steps 0x23-0x25 draw the import progress, the deck list or the character grid. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, lobby record bits, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_substate).

Draws the pulsing cursor frame of the tag set-up screen from three tables of 8 rectangles (0x08ee4c24, 0x08ee4c64, 0x08ee4ca4: x, y, width, height per slot): at third levels 0-1 a 0x88 x 0x17 frame on slot 0x08eeac74 of the first table; at levels 2-4 and 7 a frame on the cell under the cursor (deck cell, character cell with the start hint ui_title_draw_comm_start_hint, or partner cell) for the slot of the local entry or of its CPU partner, or the start button rectangle 0x08ee4ce4 when 0x08eeac70 is set. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_duel).

For steps 0xb-0x22, draws a ready mark for each of the four entries in state 2 at its slot (shifted by one for the other console's entries with two peers): the sprite comes from the table 0x08ee4d34 (row for two peers or more), the position from 0x08ee4cf4 plus the offset table 0x08ee4d14 (ui_title_draw_image, sprite table). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_duel).

Builds the 45-cell (9 x 5) character grid at 0x08eec1ca (10-byte cells: u16 character, bit 0 of +2 present, bits 1-4 variant count, bits 5-8 of the u16 at +2 current variant, +4.. variant numbers): clears it and the third level, timer, 0x08eeac70, cursor; for characters 1-0x2d listed by ui_title_is_character_listed(character, 0): the player gets one cell with variant local index + 1, other characters a cell with every variant accepted by ui_title_get_character_entry_filtered(0, character, variant) (world_count_character_variants). No return value. Side effects: the grid and cursor globals. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_character_select).

Character-select sub-screen of the wireless set-up (step 0x25) by third level: 0 builds the grid and fades in (pending level 2); 2 runs the grid input (ui_title_step_character_grid); 3 (cancel) and 4 (chosen) fade out with pending level 8 or 6; 6 copies the staged character 0x08eeb364 and variant (high nibble of 0x08eeb368) into the local entry (+0x7c, +0x80) and sends it; 7-8 return to the set-up screen like the deck select. No return value. Side effects: the local entry, title levels, fades, network traffic. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

Runs the grid input (ui_title_handle_character_grid_input): -2 sets the third level to 3; a cell index sets the blink mode 1, stages the choice (ui_title_apply_character_grid_choice) and sets level 4. No return value. Side effects: 0x08eea3e8, staging entry. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_character_select).

Input of the 9 x 5 character grid (pad repeat word): Right/Left move the cursor 0x08eeac74 by one with wrap over 45 cells, Down/Up by 9 with wrap, L/R triggers (0x100/0x200) step the cell's current variant (bits 5-8 of the cell word +2) within its count (sound 0x7a04, 0x7a07 at the ends); confirm on a present cell returns its index (sound 0x7a05; 0x7a07 on an empty cell), cancel returns -2 (0x7a06). Returns -1 otherwise. Side effects: cursor, cell variant, 0x08eeac70, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_step_character_grid).

Stages the character of grid cell (clamped to 0x2c) in the staging entry: 0x08eeb364 = character, and the high nibble of 0x08eeb368 = the normalised variant (ui_title_normalize_character_variant(character, current variant)) or, for the player character, the local peer index. No return value. Side effects: 0x08eeb364, 0x08eeb368. Callers: 1 (ui_title_step_character_grid).

Draws the character grid screen: begins a sprite batch, two framed windows with tushin captions (the grid at 0x14,0x14 size 0x1b6 x 0xf7 caption 0xb; the title tab 0x14,5 size 0x62 x 0x11 caption 0x14 colour 0x9d), the cells, the faces, a pulsing 0x2f x 0x2f frame on the cursor cell (x = 0x17 + 0x30 * column, y = 0x18 + 0x30 * row) and the variant arrows. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_draw_wireless_single_duel).

Binds d_menu01.gim of the title_menu archive and draws the 45 grid cells (9 x 5, 0x2f x 0x2f at 0x17 + 0x30 * column, 0x18 + 0x30 * row) from the duel-menu sprite parts 9/2-10 and 5/1 (ui_title_draw_duel_menu_sprite_unbound). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_character_grid).

Binds GIM 0x14 of the title GIM name array (the face sheet) and, for every present grid cell, draws the face of its character and current variant (ui_title_get_character_face_index) as a 40 x 40 tile from a 12-column sheet (u = (face % 12) * 0x28, v = (face / 12) * 0x28) at (0x1a + 0x30 * column, 0x1b + 0x30 * row). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_character_grid).

On the cursor cell of the grid, when there is a previous variant draws the left arrow and frame (menu context image 2, panel parts 0x10 and 0xf) and a 10 x 10 mini face of that variant (world_get_character_byte_3f gives the face index, tile from the face sheet GIM 0x14), and likewise on the right (parts 0x11 and 0xf) when there is a next variant. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_character_grid).

Resets the card-gift screen: clears step, third level and timer, 0x08eeac70 = 0, 0x08eeac72 = 2, colours white, binds layouts 8 (0..0x1e0) and 0xf (0..0x11). No return value. Side effects: the listed globals, layouts. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_card_gift).

Wireless sub-states 0x10-0x13 (card gift rooms) by step: 0-1 initialise and fade in, 2-3 wait, 4 binds the menu bar, 5 at the bar's frame 0x11 plays the rest and, for the receiving side (sub-state 0x13), grants the room's card 0x08eec1c4 when flag bit 0 of 0x08eec1c6 is set: marks it received (save_set_card_flag_bit7) and adds three copies (save_change_card_count(card, 1) x 3) with tushin message 1, otherwise message 3 (already received); plays 0x7a0c and goes to step 0x14; other sub-states go to 0xb and wait for confirm or cancel (ui_title_is_confirm_or_cancel_pressed); 0x14 waits for the message box and then leaves the room (request 2 when the manager state is 0x15, else 8); 0x1c/0x1e request the next sub-state with a fade. No return value. Side effects: save card counts and flags, message box, network requests, title state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).
Returns 1 when the confirm or the cancel button (system_get_confirm_button(0) / (1)) was pressed this frame (pad word +4), else 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_card_gift).

Draws the card-gift screen: layout 8, the menu bar from step 5, the top window; except for the receiving side (sub-state 0x13) the bottom window (caption table 0xc), the bottom help message window, the left panel with the gift caption and, unless the third level is 6, the help line; the list window (1, 4); and the message box 0x08eea6b4 at step 0x14. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_substate).

Draws tushin message 0x55 (for sub-states 0x10-0x13, else index 0) in a tushin message window at (9, 0x67), 0x135 x 0x10. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_card_gift).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_card_gift_caption(void *list, int item, int x, int y)
column3: Caption callback of the gift screen's left panel: draws tushin message 0x34 at (x, y + 0x10), width 300, scale 0xf, colour 0xff404040 (ui_title_draw_message_styled). item is not used. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_title_draw_left_panel_window).

Input of the wireless room list: updates the menu's list window 0x08eea9b8, computes the hovered row 0x08eea99f = scroll 0x08eeaa88 + cursor (low 5 bits of 0x08eeaa8a) and the visible cursor 0x08eea9a0; confirm on row 0 (host a room) returns 9 (sound 0x7a05); on a room row returns its index (row - 1) when the room is occupied and its value word (+4) is 0x1d or 0x1e (a compatibility value, hypothesis medium), else plays 0x7a07; cancel returns -2 (0x7a06). Returns -1 otherwise. Side effects: 0x08eea99f/0x08eea9a0, the list window, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_menu).

Draw step of title state 0xf: draws the current wireless screen (ui_title_draw_wireless_substate) and increments the timer 0x08eea3d8. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, 0x08eea3d8. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_list_window(void *list, int rows, uchar style)
column3: Configures the shared list-window record 0x08eea984 for the wireless room list (x 4, y 0x3a on the room list screen or 0x32 elsewhere, width 0x1c9, row height 0x28, frame style 0x4b, flag bits, rows = min(rows, 5), item count = 0x08eead8c, cell geometry 4,y / 0x1c9 x 0x28, item drawer ui_title_draw_wireless_list_item, byte +0x19 = style) and draws it (ui_title_draw_list_window). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: writes 0x08eea984.., the display list. Callers: 5 (ui_title_draw_wireless_card_gift, ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby, ui_title_draw_wireless_menu, ui_title_draw_wireless_rules, ...).

Reconfigures the list-window record 0x08eea984 as the room list's scroll column (x 0x1ce, y 0x3a, 0xf x 0xcc, 9 items with 5 visible, cursor from the menu 0x08eeaa88/0x08eeaa8a, no item drawer), draws it and then a scrollbar from (x + 4, y + 10) with length height - 0x14 (ui_title_calc_scrollbar_thumb, ui_title_draw_scrollbar). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: writes 0x08eea984.., the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_menu).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_top_caption(void *list, int item, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Caption callback of the wireless top window: picks the tushin message for the sub-state (4: 0x34, or 0x3a while connecting; 5: 0x35; 6: 0x36; 7: 0x3b; 8: 0x3d during set-up, then 0x3f / 0x40 by handshake step; 9: 0x3c, 0x3e, 0x42, 0x43, 0x3f or 0x40 by third level, peer count and handshake step; 0x10-0x11: 0x37; 0x12: 0x38; 0x13: 0x39) and draws it at (x, y), width, scale 0xd, white. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_title_draw_top_window).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_list_item(void *list, ushort row, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Item drawer of the wireless list window: draws the row frame (nine-slice style 0x4b with a colour variant from the room's game kind and tag mode: 4/5/6/7/8/0xd) and up to nine fields of the room record (the hovered lobby record 0x08eead90 + 0x14 * (row - 1 + scroll) on the room list, the own rules 0x08eebfdc elsewhere): game kind or single/tag label (tushin 0x5b + kind, 0x5a, 0x61 or the table 0x08ee4d64), match or offered card name (+8), LP setting (0x67 + value), time (0x97 + value, 0x13 when 0), a status label (0x10/0x0e/0x12/0x11/0x29 by screen and room state), the host name (+0x0c) and room text (+0x10), each with a sub-frame and a menu icon. Row 0 of the room list is the "host a room" row (message 0x2b, icon 4). Fields not yet set on the rule screen are hidden. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: font state, the display list. No direct caller (stored in the list record by ui_title_draw_wireless_list_window).

Returns the tushin message index of the help line for the current wireless screen: rule screen (sub-state 5, step 0xb) by row: 0x82/0x87/0x89 + the choice under the cursor (low 5 bits of 0x08eea666) for rows 1-3, 0x8b, 0x8c, 0x8d for rows 4-6; host lobby 0x90; guest lobby 0x8f (duel) or 0x92 (trade); card gift 0x37/0x38/0x39 for sub-states 0x11-0x13; 0 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_title_init_wireless_lobby, ui_title_draw_wireless_card_gift, ui_title_draw_wireless_rules).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_bottom_caption(void *list, int item, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Caption callback of the wireless bottom window: message 0x2b (room list), 0x2c (rules; greyed 0xff808080 with style byte 0x08eea99d = 0xc until the confirm row), 0x2d (lobby; greyed until at least one player is selected), 0x33 at scale 0xe (duel set-up), 0x32 (trade), 0x2f/0x2e/0x30 (gift sub-states 0x11-0x13); drawn centred (align 3) from tushin table 12. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: writes 0x08eea99d, the display list. No direct caller (callback passed to ui_title_draw_bottom_window).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_wireless_cursor_frame(void *list, int item, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Cursor callback of the wireless menus: draws a pulsing frame at (x - 4, y - 5) with the given size, or on the bottom start button (0x62, 0xf8, 0x11b x 0x15) when 0x08eeac70 is set. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. No direct caller (stored as the menu cursor callback, e.g. by ui_title_enter_wireless).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_menu_icon(void *list, int icon, int x, int y)
column3: Draws icon icon of the icon sheet described by sprite record 0x4a (copied from 0x08ee53cc; GIM from that record) at (x, y): cells are laid out 14 per row (u += (icon % 14) * cell width, v += (icon / 14) * cell height); icons 1-6 are animated by a further column offset of (animation counter 0x08eec1c2 / 10) cells; icon 0xd is a fixed 8 x 12 cell at (0x9a, 0x5f). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 4 (ui_title_draw_wireless_list_item, ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby_entry, ui_card_trade_draw_upper_side, ui_card_trade_draw_lower_side).

Loads the character-list library module for the wireless set-up: third level 0 starts loading module 0xd (system_module_load), records it in 0x08eeda4c and bit 5 of 0x08eeda48 and shows the loading overlay; level 1 waits for system_module_all_loaded, hides the overlay, marks the module loaded (bit 4 of 0x08eeda48), advances the step and clears the level. No return value. Side effects: module load, overlay, 0x08eeda48/0x08eeda4c, title step. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

Partner-pick sub-screen of the wireless tag set-up (step 0x26) by third level: 0 opens the character list in mode 2 with the module heap (ui_charalist_open, ui_charalist_update), sets 0x08eeda19 (list visible) and bit 6 of 0x08eead88, remembers the edited entry in 0x08eec38f; 1-2 update it (ui_charalist_update_ex with bit 7 of 0x08eead88): 2 cancels, 1 applies the choice (ui_title_apply_wireless_partner_pick) and sends the entry unless the session failed (bit 7), 0 keeps bit 6; 4 retries the send; 6 restores the cursor from 0x08eec38e, fades in and returns to step 8. No return value. Side effects: the character list, 0x08eead88, 0x08eeda19, entries, network traffic. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel).

Writes the character chosen in the character list (ui_charalist_get_selected_character / _variant) into the edited entry 0x08eead84 with its default deck (ui_title_get_character_default_deck), deck kind 1 (recipe) unless it is character 0x2e (kind 0), claim 2 and state 1 (ui_title_set_wireless_entry_fields). No return value. Side effects: the entry. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_partner_pick).

Wireless sub-state 0 (intro): steps 0-3 fade in from black at once and show tushin message 0x15 in the box 0x08eea6b4 (step 0x14); 0x14 waits for it to close (step 0x1e); 0x1e fades out and moves to sub-state 1 (network start). No return value. Side effects: fades, message box, title state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).
Draws the intro message box 0x08eea6b4 centred at step 0x14. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_wireless_substate).

When a library module is loaded (bit 4 of 0x08eeda48) and it is the character list (0x08eeda4c == 0xd), closes the list (ui_charalist_close) and unloads the module. No return value. Side effects: module unload, 0x08eeda48. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).

Initialises a 0x34-byte title list-window record: cleared, rectangle (0x32, 0x32, 0x17c x 0xaa) at +2..+8, colours +0x10/+0x14 = 0xffffffff, frame style byte +0x19 = 1, flag byte +0x1a cleared, cursor +0x1c = 0, visible/total counts +0x1d/+0x1e = 8, columns +0x1f = 1, cell origin (x + 5, y + 4) at +0x22/+0x24, cell size 0x187 x 0x22 at +0x26/+0x28, text +0x2c and cell callback +0x30 cleared. No return value. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 2 (ui_title_init_wireless_lobby, ui_title_init_menu).

Initialises a 0x24-byte menu tab record: +0 = 0, position 0,0 (+2/+4), size 0x40 x 0xf (+6/+8), flag byte +10 piece style 0 and art 1, colours +0x0c/+0x14 = 0xffffffff and +0x10/+0x18 = 0xff808080, +0x1c and the draw callback +0x20 cleared. No return value. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (ui_title_init_menu).

Initialises the generic title menu (four 0x24-byte tabs at +0, list window at +0x90, list box at +0xc4, flags +0x304, rectangle +0x306-+0x30c, current tab +0x30e, tab count +0x30f): kind 1 (tabbed) with bit 2 (list box), rectangle (0x6a, 0x27, 0x10c x 0xda), 2 tabs; each tab gets width = rectangle width / tab count, height 0xf and its piece style (left, middle, right); the list window spans the rectangle below the tabs with 0xf8 x 0x17 cells; then the list box (ui_title_init_menu_message_box(menu, heap)). No return value. Side effects: writes the menu. Callers: 6 (ui_title_setup_external_cards_list, ui_title_init_work, ui_title_init_tab_select_menu, ui_title_enter_wireless, ...).

Initialises the menu's list box (a BOOT list window at menu +0xc4, 0x120 bytes): resets and clears it, places it over the menu's list window rectangle (+0x92-+0x98), font size 0xd/0xe, white text, margins 5/4/6/0, 0x14 items with 8 visible, item width = cell width - margins and height = cell height, cursor callback ui_title_stub_return_list_window, heap at +0x188 and flag bits; then re-opens it (ui_title_reopen_list_window). No return value. Side effects: the list window. Callers: 2 (ui_title_setup_external_cards_list, ui_title_init_menu).

Draws a 0x34-byte title list-window record: the frame (nine-slice, colour +0x10, style bytes +0x18/+0x19) unless flag bit 0 of +0x1a; the cell frames (style 3) unless bit 3, laid out in +0x1f columns from the origin +0x22/+0x24 with cell size +0x26/+0x28 and gaps +0x0a/+0x0c; the text +0x2c (aligned with +0x20); a scrollbar along the right edge unless bit 5; each cell through the callback +0x30 (list, index, x, y, width, height); and a pulsing cursor frame on cell +0x1c unless bit 2. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 10 (ui_title_draw_menu, ui_title_draw_bottom_message_window, ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby, ui_title_draw_left_panel_window, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_menu_tab(void *list, void *tab, ushort index, int mode, char active)
column3: Draws one menu tab (0x24-byte record) when mode allows it (mode 2: inactive tabs only, 1: the active tab only, 0: always): picks three sprite records (left/middle/right) of the 0x16-byte sprite table from the piece style (bits 0-1 of +10; records 0xc/0x15, 0xf/0x18, 0x12/0x1b for active/inactive), colour +0x0c (active) or +0x10, texture row from bits 2-3 of +10, stretches the middle piece to the tab width (+6, minimum 7) and draws them at (+2, +4); then calls the tab callback +0x20 (list, index, x, y, width, height). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_menu).

Draws a menu of kind 2 (panel): the panel frame (style 0x30) over the rectangle +0x306-+0x30c, two fixed header sprites at x + 0x1b and x + 0x73 with the header callback +0x310 (list, index, x + 2, y, width 0x53/0x163, 0), the row frames and row bars (style 0x46) for the +0xae visible rows unless bit 3 of +0xaa, the highlighted bar and pulsing cursor on row +0xac unless bit 2, a scrollbar unless bit 5, and each row through the callback +0xc0. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_menu).

Updates a generic title menu: any button press resets the cursor blink mode; R/L triggers (0x200/0x100) switch the current tab +0x30e within the tab count +0x30f; when the menu has a list box (bit 2 of +0x304) updates it (ui_update_list_window on menu +0xc4) and mirrors its scroll and cursor into +0xab/+0xac. Returns the list-box result (-1 running, -2 cancel, -3 idle, or the chosen item); without a list box the return value is an uninitialised register in the decompilation. Side effects: the menu, blink mode. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_tab_select, ui_title_update_external_cards).

Draws a generic title menu: copies the current tab's art row into +0xa9; kind 1 draws the list window +0x90 and every tab (ui_title_draw_menu_tab, active = current tab +0x30e); kind 2 draws the panel (ui_title_draw_menu_list_panel); then the list box +0xc4 when present (ui_draw_list_window). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, menu +0xa9. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_wireless_menu, ui_title_draw_external_cards, ui_title_draw_tab_select).

column2: void * ui_title_call_draw_nine_slice_frame(void *list, uint color, int x, int y, int width, int height, int style, int variant, int flag)
column3: Forwards its nine arguments unchanged to ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_list_window, ui_title_draw_wireless_list_item, ui_title_draw_menu_list_panel).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_pulsing_cursor_frame(void *list, uint color, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Draws the title's cursor frame (nine-slice style 0x28) around (x, y, width, height), enlarged by 1 or 2 pixels on each side as bit 3 of the frame counter 0x08eea3d4 toggles (a pulse every 8 frames). With a blink mode set (bits 0-1 of 0x08eeda48) the frame is shown only on 2 of every 4 calls (counter 0x08eede62, wraps at 0x1000), and mode 2 returns to steady after 15 calls (ui_title_set_cursor_blink_mode(0)). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, 0x08eede62, possibly 0x08eeda48. Callers: 16 (ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_cursor, ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby, ui_title_draw_comm_cursor, ui_title_draw_comm_single_duel, ...).

Sets the cursor blink mode in bits 0-1 of 0x08eeda48 (0 steady, 1 blinking while a choice is being processed, 2 blink briefly) and resets the blink counter 0x08eede62. No return value. Side effects: 0x08eeda48, 0x08eede62. Callers: 24 (ui_title_handle_comm_tag_slot_input, ui_title_update_wireless_deck_select, ui_title_handle_wireless_rules_input, ui_title_update_wireless_menu, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame_style_70(void *list, int highlighted, uint color, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Draws a row bar with nine-slice style 0x46 (70), variant 1 when highlighted is non-zero, else variant 0. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_menu_list_panel).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame(void *list, uint color, int x, int y, int width, int height, int style, int variant, int flag)
column3: Draws a stretchable frame from consecutive 0x16-byte sprite records of the table 0x08ee4d70 starting at record style (9 pieces: corners, edges and centre; corner sizes from the halfwords +0x0e/+0x10 of the first, third and seventh records): edges and centre are stretched to fill width x height; style 0x46 uses 3 pieces with a v offset of 14 * variant, 0x49 one piece, 0x5d three pieces drawn twice, 0x4b and 0x54 pick a 10 x 10 colour cell from variant (4-0x15 or 0x16-0x1b) in a 4-column grid, other styles shift the v coordinate by 32 * variant; flag 1 selects a 12-piece layout. The GIM is the one named by the style record (title_menu archive); colour color. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 4 (ui_title_draw_pulsing_cursor_frame, ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame_style_30, ui_title_call_draw_nine_slice_frame, ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame_style_70).

Copies a 0x16-byte title sprite record (bytes +0/+1 and ten halfwords +0x02-+0x14: offsets, size, texture u/v, extent, draw size). Returns dst. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame_style_30(void *list, uint color, int x, int y, int width, int height)
column3: Draws a frame with nine-slice style 0x1e (30), variant 0 (ui_title_draw_nine_slice_frame). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_menu_list_panel).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_fixed_menu_sprite(void *list, uint color, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the fixed header sprite described by the 0x16-byte record copied from 0x08ee50ca (texture u/v +0x0a/+0x0c, size +0x0e/+0x10, draw size +0x12/+0x14; GIM of sprite record 0x1e) at (x, y) with colour color. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_menu_list_panel).

column2: void ui_title_calc_scrollbar_thumb(short *out_pos, short *out_length, void *window, int x, short y, short length)
column3: Computes a scrollbar thumb for a title list-window record (bytes +0x1b absolute index, +0x1c cursor in the page, +0x1d item count, +0x1e visible count): thumb length = (length - 10) + 8 - (length - 10) * (count - visible) / (count - 1), thumb position = y + 1 + (index - cursor) * ((length - 2) - thumb length) / (count - visible), with the divisors clamped to at least 1. x is not used. No return value. Side effects: writes *out_pos and *out_length. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_menu_list_panel, ui_title_draw_list_window, ui_title_draw_wireless_scroll_list).

column2: void ui_title_calc_scrollbar_thumb_ex(short *out_pos, short *out_length, int count, int visible, int index, int cursor, int x, short y, short length)
column3: Same computation as ui_title_calc_scrollbar_thumb with the item count, visible count, absolute index and page cursor passed explicitly (the ninth argument is on the stack); x is not used. No return value. Side effects: writes *out_pos and *out_length. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_deck_select_list).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_scrollbar(void *list, uint color, int x, int y, int length, int thumb_pos, int thumb_length)
column3: Draws a vertical scrollbar from the sprite records 0x31-0x3a of the 0x16-byte table (GIM of record 0x31): the track (records 0x35-0x37 top, stretched middle, bottom) and the thumb (0x38-0x3a, stretched to thumb_length at thumb_pos), then the up/down arrows (0x31-0x34), shown only when the thumb is not at that end; the arrows 0x33/0x34 fade with the frame counter (alpha 0xff - (counter & 0xf) * 0xff / 15). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 4 (ui_title_draw_menu_list_panel, ui_title_draw_list_window, ui_title_draw_wireless_scroll_list, ui_title_draw_deck_select_list).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_tushin_message_window(void *list, int index, short x, short y, short width, short height)
column3: Configures the list-window record 0x08eeac08 as a single framed cell (frame style 0x54/0x17, rectangle x, y, width, height, cell inset 3/2) and draws it; when index is non-zero draws tushin message index (table 12) inside it, fit to width, scale 0xd, white. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: writes 0x08eeac08.., the display list. Callers: 4 (ui_title_draw_wireless_rules_help, ui_title_draw_wireless_lobby_caption, ui_title_draw_comm_rules_help, ui_title_draw_wireless_card_gift_help).

Configures the shared list-window record 0x08eea984 as the bottom button window and draws it: (0x109, 0xf3, 0xd1 x 0x17) in the communication screens after sub-state 2 and the wireless duel set-ups (0xf sub-states 8/9), else (0x62, 0xf8, 0x11b x 0x15); frame style 0x4b with variant style, one cell, the cell drawn by caption_callback. Third level 0 (team): ui_title_handle_comm_tag_team_input; result 0 or 1 selects team slot 0x08eec38c = 2 or 6, panel mode 4, 8 positions, third level 1; -2 goes back to the rules (pending sub-state 2). Third level 1 (slot): holds layout 0xc at frame 0xe and runs ui_title_handle_comm_tag_slot_input: 1 starts the duel (BGM fade, layouts 0xd 0xaf..0xc1 and 0xc 0..0xe, step 0xe); 0 on the team slot returns to the team choice, on another slot stores it (0x08eec38d = 4, 0x08eec38e = slot) and goes to step 10 with pending sub-state 6 (even slots, character) or 7 (odd slots, deck); -2 returns to the team choice. No return value. Side effects: cursor and step words, 0x08eec38c..0x08eec38e, the setup panel, layouts, BGM. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_comm_menu).

Input of the tag-duel team choice: any press resets the cursor blink; right/left cycle 0x08eeac74 over the 0x08eeac7c positions with sound 0x7a04; when it changes and the target team's first slot (setup slot 0 or 2) is not the local player (character 1), swaps the two 0x100-byte deck records 0x08eed614 and 0x08eed814 (ui_title_copy_deck_record) and swaps slots 0 and 2 (names, and for slot type 2 the deck names 0x08eed6d4/0x08eed8d4). Returns 0x08eeac74 on confirm (sound 0x7a05), -2 on cancel (sound 0x7a06), else -1. Side effects: cursor word, the deck records, setup slots, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_comm_tag_duel).

Input handler of the tag-duel slot cursor 0x08eeac74 (8 positions in two columns of 0x08eeac7c / 2; even positions are character slots, odd ones deck slots; 0x08eeac70 = 1 means the start button below the grid is selected). While no random roll runs (0x08eede60 == 0): Square (0x8000) on a character slot whose setup slot is not the local player (character 1) starts a 60-frame random character roll (sound 0x7a05, 0x08eec38e = cursor, ui_title_refresh_comm_player_slot), otherwise buzzer 0x7a07; up/down step within the column (ui_title_step_comm_tag_slot_cursor(+-1)) or move to/from the start button; left/right jump between columns (+-column size); sound 0x7a04. Confirm returns 0x08eeac70 (0 = a slot, 1 = start) with sound 0x7a05, cancel returns -2 (0x7a06). During a roll it refreshes the rolled slot each frame for 0x3c frames. Returns -1 otherwise. Side effects: cursor words, 0x08eede60, 0x08eec38e, setup slots, sounds, blink mode. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_comm_tag_duel).

Adds delta to the tag slot cursor 0x08eeac74; when the new position is a character slot (0, 2, 4, 6) whose setup slot (ui_title_map_cursor_to_player_slot(4, pos)) holds the local player (character 1), skips one more position (back by 1 for delta -1 or 0, forward otherwise). No return value. Side effects: writes 0x08eeac74 and the mapped slot 0x08eec38f. Callers: 1 (ui_title_handle_comm_tag_slot_input).

Draws the tag-duel setup screen: layouts 0xd and 0x10 with the menu-bar label, sound 0x7a81 at frame 0x7b and 0x7a82 at frame 0xaf of layout 0xd; from step 9 the top window, the bottom window (style 0xc, 0xd from the slot choice on) and, on a character slot that is not the local player, the start hint; the setup panel; layout 0xc during the slot choice; from step 9 a pulsing cursor frame from the 8 x 4-word rectangle table 0x08ee5ae0 (team choice uses entries 2 or 6) or, on the start button, a fixed frame at (0x109, 0xf3) size 0xd1 x 0x17. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_comm_menu).
Wrapper: returns ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel(list). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_comm_menu).

Loads the character list module for the communication menu (sub-state 0): at third level 0 requests module 0xd (system_module_load(0xd), remembered in 0x08eeda4c) and shows the loading overlay; at level 1 waits for system_module_all_loaded, then sets bits 4-5 of 0x08eeda48 to 1 (module loaded), moves to sub-state 1 step 0 and hides the overlay. No return value. Side effects: module loading, 0x08eeda48/0x08eeda4c, state words, the loading overlay. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_comm_step).

Step-9 update of the character pick (sub-state 6): runs ui_charalist_update; on 1 (chosen) stores the selected character and variant, its default deck (ui_title_get_character_default_deck) and name (world_call_get_character_name_string(0, character, variant)) into the remembered setup slot 0x08eec38f (ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_name(slot, character, variant, 0, deck, name)); on 1 or 2 (cancel) clears 0x08eeda19 and returns to the sub-state stored in 0x08eec38d (3 single, 4 tag; third level 1 for tag) at step 0x10. No return value. Side effects: setup slot, state words, 0x08eeda19. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_comm_menu).

Fills setup slot with a CPU opponent: when ui_title_stub_return_1_wireless returns 0 uses character 2 variant 0, otherwise asks the character list for a random pick (ui_charalist_e11636ec on the title heap, then the selected character and variant) and marks the slot type 0 instead of 1 when the character is 0x2e (world_is_character_2e); stores the character's default deck and name (world_call_get_character_name_string) with ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_name, and sets 0x08eeac7c = 8. No return value. Side effects: the setup slot, 0x08eeac7c, character-list state. Callers: 3 (ui_title_handle_comm_tag_slot_input, ui_title_handle_comm_single_duel_input, ui_title_init_comm_player_slots).

Maps a setup-screen cursor to a duel setup slot and stores it in 0x08eec38f: for the tag screen (screen 4) cursor 0-1 -> slot 1, 2-3 -> 0, 4-5 -> 3, 6-7 -> 2; for the single-duel screen cursor 2-3 -> slot 0, 0-1 -> slot 1. Returns the slot (unchanged for other cursors). Side effects: writes 0x08eec38f. Callers: 7 (ui_title_step_comm_tag_slot_cursor, ui_title_handle_comm_tag_slot_input, ui_title_handle_comm_single_duel_input, ui_title_load_external_decks, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_comm_top_caption(void *list, int item, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Caption callback of the top window: draws tushin_msg string 0x22 (rules, sub-state 2), 0x23 (single duel, 3) or 0x25 / 0x24 (tag duel team / slot choice) in white at (x, y), width, scale 0xd. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. No direct caller (passed to ui_title_draw_top_window).

Clears the deck selection lists: the stored-deck list 0x08eec3f8 (0x132 bytes, 0x33 six-byte entries), the recipe list 0x08eec52a (0xad4 bytes, 0x1ce entries), the entry count 0x08eed5fe, the per-tab cursor and scroll arrays 0x08eed600/0x08eed606 (3 halfwords each) and the words 0x08eec394..0x08eec3a0. No return value. Side effects: those globals. Callers: 2 (ui_title_enter_deck_select, ui_title_enter_wireless_deck_select).

Enters the deck selection list for the remembered setup slot: clears the lists and cursor words (6 visible rows), maps the cursor to its slot and reads the slot's character into 0x08eec394; for the player (character 1) or character 0x2e it offers tabs (2, or 3 with the external-deck tab when the external list is loaded, load state 2 in 0x08eec3ac) with tab layout base frame 0x08eec390 = 0 or 2, otherwise one tab with base frame 5; binds layout 4 at that frame and builds the list (ui_title_build_deck_list). No return value. Side effects: the deck lists, cursor words, 0x08eec390/0x08eec394, layout slot 4. Callers: 1 (ui_title_load_external_decks).

Builds the deck lists of character into 0x08eec394. For an ordinary character: up to 10 recipe ids from its save record (save_get_character_record: count at +0, ids from +2), keeping those with a recipe level (deck_get_recipe_level), preceded by its own edited deck when save flag byte1 bit 0 is set (deck_copy_slot_cards); entries go to the 6-byte recipe list 0x08eec52a (bits 0-1 validity from ui_title_check_deck_valid_copy, bits 2-11 ordinal, +2 recipe id). For the player or character 0x2e: the recipe list over all owned recipes 1..0x1cd (save_get_recipe_entry bit 0; +4 = entry bits 1-8), the stored-deck list 0x08eec3f8 (entry 0 = the current deck via deck_copy_member_slot_cards(0), entries 1..0x32 the stored decks with a non-zero first word, cards at +0x54) and the external list 0x08eecffe (0x08eec3b4 records of 0x1c0 bytes, cards at +0x100). Sets the item count 0x08eed5fe, 0x08eeac7c (0x33 for the player) and the visible rows 0x08eeac81 (max 6). No return value. Side effects: the list globals. Callers: 3 (ui_title_get_character_default_deck, ui_title_enter_deck_select, ui_title_enter_wireless_deck_select).

Copies 0xc0 bytes of the deck card block to the stack and returns deck_check_deck_valid(copy, 0) (the value is used as the 2-bit validity of a list entry: 0 invalid, 1 valid, 2 shown in the highlight colour; the decompiler drops the return). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_title_build_deck_list).

Returns 0 for the player and character 0x2e; otherwise builds the character's deck list (ui_title_build_deck_list) and returns the recipe id of the last entry with non-zero validity in 0x08eec52a (1 when none). Side effects: rebuilds the deck list globals. Callers: 5 (ui_title_refresh_comm_player_slot, ui_title_update_comm_partner_pick, ui_title_get_charalist_choice, ui_title_init_comm_player_slots, ...).

Step-9 update of the deck selection (sub-state 7): runs ui_title_handle_deck_select_input(character 0x08eec394, &tab 0x08eec39c, &entry 0x08eec3a0); on a choice applies it to the remembered slot (ui_title_apply_selected_deck) with blink mode 1; on a choice or cancel (-2) goes to step 10 with pending sub-state 0x08eec38d (pending step 0x10, third level 1 for the tag screen). No return value. Side effects: the setup slot, state and pending words. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_comm_menu).

column2: bool ui_title_get_deck_list_entry(int character, int tab, uint index, uint *out_id)
column3: Resolves a deck list entry: for an ordinary character the recipe id of entry index (0x08eec52c + index * 6); for the player / character 0x2e by tab: 0 stored deck index (valid when 0x08eec3f8 entry bits 0-1 are set), 2 external deck index (0x08eecffe), 1 the recipe id (0x08eec52a entry). Stores it in *out_id and returns true when valid and out_id is not null. Side effects: writes *out_id. Callers: 2 (ui_title_apply_selected_deck, ui_title_handle_deck_select_input).

column2: int ui_title_apply_selected_deck(int slot, int character, int tab, uint index)
column3: Applies a deck list choice to setup slot: resolves the entry (ui_title_get_deck_list_entry); for an external deck (tab 2) copies its 0x40-byte name to 0x08eed6d4 + slot * 0x100 and its cards (record +0x100) to the deck record 0x08eed614 + slot * 0x100 (ui_title_copy_deck_cards) and sets the slot with a deck name (ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_deck_name), otherwise ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot(slot, -1, -1, tab, id). Returns the resolved id, or -1 when the entry is invalid. Side effects: the deck records and setup slot. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_comm_deck_select).

Accelerating key repeat for up/down (pad held bits 0x50): while the same direction is held, counts frames in 0x08eed612 (max 0x78) and sets the repeat interval to 4 - frames / 0x1e (system_pad_set_repeat keeping the delay from system_pad_get_repeat); when released or when enable is 0, clears 0x08eed610/0x08eed612 and restores the default repeat (system_pad_init_repeat). No return value. Side effects: pad repeat settings, 0x08eed610/0x08eed612. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_external_cards, ui_title_handle_deck_select_input).

Input of the deck selection list (with ui_title_update_key_repeat): with several tabs (0x08eeac72), right/R/Square or left/L switch the tab 0x08eeac70 with sound 0x7a0d, saving and restoring the per-tab cursor (0x08eed600) and scroll (0x08eed606) and setting layout 4 to frame base 0x08eec390 + tab; for the player / character 0x2e the item count follows the tab (0x33 stored decks, 0x08eed5fe recipes, 0x08eec3b4 external). Up/down move the cursor 0x08eeac74 and scroll row 0x08eeac80 (6 rows) with wrap and sound 0x7a04. Confirm: buzzer 0x7a07 for an empty list or invalid entry, otherwise stores the tab (always 1 for ordinary characters) in *out_tab and the entry id in *out_id and returns the cursor (sound 0x7a05). Cancel returns -2 (sound 0x7a06). Returns -1 otherwise. Side effects: cursor words, pad repeat, layout 4, sounds, the outputs. Callers: 2 (ui_title_handle_wireless_deck_select_input, ui_title_update_comm_deck_select).

Draws the deck selection list: layout 4, the tab captions (title_msg 0x5b, 0x5c, 0x5d; the selected one white, others grey 0xff808080) clipped to the scissor (0xa7, 0x26, 0x92, 0xf) at x positions from the table 0x08ee5b60, up to 6 rows (row background ui_title_draw_table_sprite(0x66, tab, 0xaa, y) and ui_title_draw_deck_select_entry at y = 0x38 + row * 0x1d), the scrollbar (ui_title_calc_scrollbar_thumb_ex, ui_title_draw_scrollbar at (0x130, 0x41), length 0x9d) and a pulsing cursor frame at (0xa8, 0x36 + row * 0x1d) size 0x88 x 0x21. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_wireless_single_duel, ui_title_draw_comm_menu, ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_duel).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_table_sprite(void *list, int sprite, int variant, int x, int y)
column3: Draws a five-piece horizontal sprite strip: binds the GIM of sprite record sprite in the 0x16-byte sprite table 0x08ee4d70 (ui_title_get_sprite_record_gim_name, title_menu archive), then draws the five records whose indices are in the table 0x08ee5b78, each at the running x (advanced by the previous piece's width +0x0e), y, with u from +0x0a, v from +0x0c + variant * 0x20, size +0x0e x +0x10. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_deck_select_list).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_deck_select_entry(void *list, int index, int x, int y)
column3: Draws one deck list row: chooses the entry by character and tab (recipe list 0x08eec52a with recipe id and owner character, stored deck list 0x08eec3f8, external list 0x08eecffe); unless the entry is valid (1) it draws a 0x84 x 0x1d overlay tinted with ambient 0x40000000 (invalid, 0) or uses blue text 0xff0070ff (2). Content: entry 0 of the stored tab is the current deck (deck_get_member_slot_name(0)); stored decks show icon 0x6b, the name (+4) and the date (ui_title_draw_date_time from +0x44) or a fixed empty-slot string; recipes show icon 0x6c and deck_get_recipe_name (icon 0x6a and title_msg 0x5e for ids >= 0x1ce), the owner character's name at scale 10 and the ordinal as sprite digits; external decks icon 0x6d and the record name. When the highlighted entry has validity 2 it adds title_msg 0x12 at the bottom of the screen. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_deck_select_list).

column2: int ui_title_deck_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, ushort *text)
column3: Read from the disassembly (Ghidra shows an empty body): pixel-to-font-unit wrapper that shifts x, y and width left by 6 (1/64-pixel units) and tail-jumps to the import stub of system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) (vram_offset -1 in t0). Returns that result. Side effects: those of system_font_draw_text_fit_width (glyph cache, text sprites). Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_deck_select_entry).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_date_time(void *list, int x, int y, ushort *date)
column3: Draws a date and time from five halfwords at scale 9 x 10: year % 100, month, day, hour and minute as two-digit numbers (ui_title_draw_number_text, step 6) with a separator character from 0x08ee5ba4 between the date fields and ':' between hour and minute. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_deck_select_entry).

column2: int ui_title_date_draw_text_px(int x, int y, int width, ushort *text)
column3: Read from the disassembly (Ghidra shows an empty body): shifts x, y and width left by 6 and tail-jumps to the import stub of system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text). Returns that result. Side effects: those of system_font_draw_text. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_date_time).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_number_text(void *list, short x, short y, int value, short step, ushort digits, int pad)
column3: Draws value in font digits right to left, starting at x - step and moving left by step per digit, for at most digits digits; stops early when the remaining value is 0 unless pad is non-zero (leading zeros). Each digit is drawn by ui_title_draw_text_to_screen_edge inside an external font list. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_date_time).

column2: int ui_title_draw_text_to_screen_edge(int x, int y, ushort *text)
column3: Read from the disassembly (Ghidra shows a meaningless return value): draws text from (x, y) with the rest of the screen as width limit: tail-jumps to the import stub of system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (0x1e0 - x) << 6, text) (0x1e0 = 480, the screen width). Returns that result. Side effects: those of system_font_draw_text. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_number_text).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_sprite_number(void *list, short x, short y, uint value, short digits)
column3: Draws value with sprite digits from GIM 8 of the title_menu archive (ui_title_get_gim_name(8)): digits cells of 7 x 9 pixels drawn right to left from x + (digits - 1) * 6, step 6; digit d is taken at u = 0x40 + (d % 5) * 7, v = 0x2e + (d / 5) * 9. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_deck_select_entry).

Enters the language selection: fade in with pending step increment, initialises the list menu 0x08eeac84 (byte 0x08eeac8a = 4 in boot state 0x2d, else 0; 0x08eeac8c = 5, the item count (hypothesis, medium); fade parameters via ui_title_init_list_fade(menu, 4, 1); item draw callback ui_title_draw_language_item, item box (0x8c, 0x80, 200, 0x1a)), sets the selection from the current language 0x08eeda14 (cursor = language - 1, 0x08eeda18 = language) and binds layouts 5, 6 (0..0x1e0) and 0xe (0..0x10). No return value. Side effects: the list menu block 0x08eeac84..0x08eead00, 0x08eeda18, layout slots. Callers: 2 (ui_title_enter_state, ui_title_start_boot_language_select).

Update of the language selection (sub-state 0x08eea3e0): 1 waits for layout 0xe frame 0x10 (input disabled before) and starts its loop; 1-2 run the list menu: items 0-4 store the cursor and the chosen language 0x08eeda18 = item + 1 (English, German, French, Italian, Spanish; Japanese 0 is not offered) and go to 3, cancel requests the exit fade to sub-state 5; 3 requests the same fade once the list's fade flag 0x08eeacf8 clears. Sub-state 5: in boot mode (state 0x2d) frees the archive slot of the old language, stores the language (save_set_language) and resets state/sub-state and the boot step 0x08eedfbc; otherwise enters main menu sub-state 0xb directly when unchanged, or loads the new language archive (ui_title_load_language_archive(1)) and card info (card_db_load_cardinfo) with the loading overlay (sub-state 6); 7 waits for card_db_bind_cardinfo and enters main menu sub-state 0xb. No return value. Side effects: language, archives, card info, state words, 0x08eea3fe. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_boot_language, ui_title_update_state).

While sub-state < 5 draws layouts 6 and 5, from sub-state 1 layout 0xe with the menu-bar label, the flag cursor (ui_title_draw_language_cursor for 0x08eeacd9) and the list menu 0x08eeac84. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (ui_title_draw_boot_language, ui_title_draw_state).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_language_item(void *list, ushort item, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Item callback of the language list: draws the language name (title_msg 0x31, 0x33, 0x32, 0x34, 0x35 for items 0-4) centred in the item box (ui_title_get_message_centered, ui_title_draw_text) at scale 0xf in the list item colour (ui_title_get_list_item_color), then the item's flag icon at (x + 0x10, y + 4) (ui_title_draw_language_icon). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. No direct caller (installed by ui_title_enter_language_select).

Draws the large flag picture for the highlighted language at (0xc6, 0x35): binds image record 0x23 of the title_menu archive and picks the cell in a 3-column grid (cell size from the record at 0x08ee8a68/0x08ee8a6a, origin 0x08ee8a64/0x08ee8a66; items 0-1 first row at columns 1-2, items 2-4 second row). Uses the selection 0x08eeacdd, not the argument (hypothesis, confidence medium). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_language_select).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_language_icon(void *list, int item, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the small flag icon of language item at (x, y) from image record 0x24 of the title_menu archive: u = origin 0x08ee8afc + (width + 1) * (item + 1), v from 0x08ee8afe, size from 0x08ee8b00/0x08ee8b02. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_language_item).
Clears the boot language step 0x08eedfbc. No return value. Side effects: writes 0x08eedfbc. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_state).

Update of the boot-time language state by step 0x08eedfbc: 0 sets step 1 and sub-state 0; 1 runs the autoload (ui_title_update_boot_autoload); 2 starts the language selection (ui_title_start_boot_language_select); 3 runs it (ui_title_update_language_select); 4 does nothing. No return value. Side effects: 0x08eedfbc, the sub-state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_state).
Draws the language selection while the boot language step 0x08eedfbc is 3. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

Boot autoload (sub-state 0x08eea3e0): 0 reloads the sound banks under the loading overlay (audio_title_reload_sound_banks(1)); 1 opens save request 3 (load) on the title heap; 2 polls save_update_task: 3 (no save) goes to the language selection (boot step 2), 2 (loaded) takes the saved language into 0x08eeda14, applies it (save_set_language) and loads the card info; 3 waits for card_db_bind_cardinfo and resets state, sub-state and the boot step. No return value. Side effects: save task, language, card info, sound banks, state words. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_boot_language).

Boot step 2 (no save found): sub-state 0 shows the loading overlay, reloads the sound banks (audio_title_reload_sound_banks(0)) and loads the language archive (ui_title_load_language_archive(0)); sub-state 1 waits (advanced elsewhere); sub-state 2 hides the overlay, sets boot step 0x08eedfbc = 3 and enters the language selection. Mirrors the sub-state in 0x08eea3fe. No return value. Side effects: overlay, sound banks, archives, state words. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_boot_language).

Initialises the title module: clears the soft-reset inhibit, changes the current thread attribute (sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000)), clears the 0x3bec-byte work area from 0x08eea3d4, creates the title heap at 0x08eedfc0 with 0xc00000 bytes (pointer in 0x08eea404), hides the loading overlay, enables font colour codes, creates the text line (ui_title_create_text_line(heap, 0x27, 0x140, 0xe, 0, 0)), initialises the three message boxes 0x08eea594, 0x08eea6b4, 0x08eea7d4, the two list menus 0x08eeac84 and 0x08eead04 and the menu block 0x08eea8f4. No return value. Side effects: the whole title work area, heap creation, font state. Callers: 1 (system_title_scene_start).

Wrapper that runs ui_title_draw_state. No return value. Side effects: through ui_title_draw_state. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, the title scene's draw entry; hypothesis, medium).

Releases the title module's resources: frees all windows of the window list 0x08eea4d0, destroys the text line, frees the external deck list (ui_title_free_external_list(0)) and unloads the library module. No return value. Side effects: heap frees, module unload. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer, the title scene's release entry; hypothesis, medium).

column2: void ui_title_enter_main_menu(short state, ushort sub_state, short no_fade)
column3: Enter function of the main menu (state 9): loads audio tracks 0x2c5 and 0x2cf; when no_fade is 0 and the PSID checksum changed (save_psid_checksum_changed) diverts to sub-state 0xf (warning) remembering the requested sub-state in 0x08eea3f8. Sub-state 7 reopens the database submenu (main menu cursor 4) and 5 the deck submenu (cursor 2), restoring the submenu cursor 0x08eead59 from 0x08eeac74; 0xf opens the main menu at 0x08eea3f8 - 3 and sets bit 0 of 0x08eea3fa; others open the main menu at cursor sub_state - 3 (0 for 0). With a fade (no_fade 0) it starts the fade-in, uses pending sub-state words, binds layouts 5 and 6 (0..0x1e0) and plays BGM track 1 with fade. Clears step, third level, frame counter and 0x08eea424/0x08eea428. No return value. Side effects: state and pending words, list menus, layouts, audio. Callers: 2 (ui_title_enter_state, ui_title_update_psid_warning).

Update of the main menu by sub-state: 1 initialises the message box 0x08eea7d4 and advances; 2 runs the main list (ui_title_handle_main_menu); 3 the first submenu; 5 the deck submenu; 7 the database submenu; 10 the save (ui_title_update_main_menu_save); 0xf the PSID warning. Mirrors the sub-state in 0x08eea3fe. No return value. Side effects: through the sub-state handlers. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_state).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_character_face(void *list, ushort character, int x, int y, int scale, int uv_offset, int inset, void *face_gim, void *base_gim)
column3: Draws a character face portrait scaled by scale percent when both GIMs are given. Generic characters 0x79-0x8d (and characters whose world byte 9 is 5) use a fixed 0x33 x 0x54 cell of base_gim (cells at u 0/0x33/0x66/0x99/0xcc, v 0x54/0xa8/0xfc, 0x10b for 0x8b), drawn at y - scale * 6 / 100. Other characters read three bytes from world_get_character_model_ids (fails -> nothing drawn): byte 1 picks a 0x33 x 0x40 column of base_gim drawn at y + scale * 16 / 100, then face_gim is bound with texture level / palette (byte 2 & 0xf) (field_3d_gim_emit_texture_level) and a 0x33 x 0x32 expression cell chosen by byte 0 (u = (b % 10 % 5) * 0x33, v = (b / 10) * 100 + (b % 10 / 5) * 0x32) is drawn at (x, y). Sets ambient white and linear texture filtering first; uv_offset shifts the texture coordinates and inset the sprite extent. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_call_draw_character_face).

column2: int ui_title_start_osk(ushort *text, ushort *prompt, int max_length, void *on_done)
column3: Starts the system on-screen keyboard (sceUtilityOskInitStart) for the UTF-16 buffer text: calls system_net_set_word_bafc(0), clears the 0x1b4-byte OSK block 0x09aedfcc, sets the soft-reset inhibit, copies up to 0x18 characters of text into the initial-text buffer 0x09aee044 (a doubled '$' collapses to one), fills the parameter block 0x09aedfd0 (size 0x40, OSK language from the halfword table 0x08ee8c38 indexed by the save language 0-5 (1 when out of range), button swap = confirm button is not Circle 0x2000, thread priorities 0x32/0x34/0x33/0x10, one field: input type (1 for Japanese), prompt, initial text, output buffer 0x09aee076, max_length) and remembers text and on_done in 0x09aee178/0x09aee17c. On success fades the screen out (system_start_fade_out(2, 0xa0000000, 8)) and sets state 1. Returns the sceUtilityOskInitStart result. Side effects: OSK block, soft-reset inhibit, fade. Callers: 2 (ui_title_open_name_osk, ui_partner_menu_update_name_entry).

Polls the on-screen keyboard (state byte 0x09aedfcc): in states 1-3 draws the fade into GE layer layer (system_ge_select_layer, system_draw_fade, system_ge_commit_layer_pointer) and moves 1 -> 2 / 3 -> 4 when the fade ends; syncs the GE (sceGuSync). In states 1-2, when sceUtilityOskGetStatus reports 3 (or 2 and sceUtilityOskUpdate(2) returns non-zero), shuts the OSK down; when the result word 0x09aedfec is 0 (accepted) copies the output text 0x09aee076 back into the caller's buffer, doubling every '$'; calls the completion callback with (output, shutdown result), fades in and sets state 3. State 4 calls system_net_set_word_bafc(1), clears the soft-reset inhibit and returns 1; state 0 returns 1 too. Returns 0 while running. Side effects: OSK state, caller's text buffer, fade, soft-reset inhibit. Callers: 1 (ui_title_poll_name_osk).
