Lays out the text line records with the window's font (ui_title_begin_text_line_font / ui_title_end_text_line_font): reads the inner rectangle of window 0x09aee1d4 (ui_window_get_inner_rect), stores the inner width in 0x09aee260 and, for each of the 0x09aee25c lines, the 0x18-byte record 0x09aee274 + i * 0x18 = {x, y + i * (line height + 3), 0, line height, 0} (line height = system_font_get_line_height() >> 6); clears 0x09aee2bc/0x09aee2c0. No return value. Side effects: the line records. Callers: 1 (ui_title_set_text_line_text).

Moves the text line window to the current origin vector 0x09aee2e8 (window x/y at 0x09aee1e0/0x09aee1e2) and recomputes each line record's x and y (y = inner y + i * (line height + 1 + 3)) from the window's inner rectangle. No return value. Side effects: the window position and line records. Callers: 1 (ui_title_reset_text_line).

Saves the font flags (system_font_get_flags) and sets the text line's font state: trimmed wrap spaces on, ruby off, colour codes on, scale from the window font size byte 0x09aee220, shadow from 0x09aee210, colour 0x09aee224 and end-y offset 0xc0. Returns the saved flags for ui_title_end_text_line_font. Side effects: global font state. Callers: 3 (ui_title_split_text_lines, ui_title_relayout_text_lines, ui_title_layout_text_lines).

Restores the font flags saved by ui_title_begin_text_line_font (system_font_set_flags) and resets the end-y offset to 0. No return value. Side effects: global font state. Callers: 3 (ui_title_split_text_lines, ui_title_relayout_text_lines, ui_title_layout_text_lines).

When a text is set (0x09aee264), splits it over the text line's lines: for each of the 0x09aee25c line records (0x09aee274 + i * 0x18) stores the start offset (+0x10) and asks ui_title_text_line_draw_text_box_px(x, y, inner width 0x09aee260, line height + 2, text + offset) how many characters fit (+0x14), skipping one following space; uses the line font state with colour 0. No return value. Side effects: the line records, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_set_text_line_text).

Allocates the 0x98-byte duel setup panel from heap (pointer in 0x09aee300), clears it, stores heap (+0x00) and the layout archive (+0x04), binds the character name text tables (ui_title_bind_tn_text_tables) for modes 8-10 and initialises the panel for mode (ui_title_init_duel_setup_panel). No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, 0x09aee300. Callers: 2 (ui_title_enter_wireless, ui_title_enter_comm_menu).

Frees the duel setup panel 0x09aee300 on the heap stored in its first word. No return value. Side effects: heap free. Callers: 3 (ui_title_start_comm_duel, ui_title_update_wireless, ui_title_update_comm_menu).

Clears the panel's 100 bytes from +0x10, stores mode (+0x11) and the network-active flag (+0x10, system_get_net_active_flag), clears +0x12. Modes 0-7 set the phase +0x0c = 4 (idle). Modes 8/9 load the players from the duel setup buffer (ui_title_load_duel_setup_players), phase 2, set +0x12 when scene 6 was called from 2 (system_scene_get_caller(6) == 2), bind the panel layouts (1: frames 0..0x1d single or 100..0x81 tag, 2: 0..0x3b or 100..0x9f when buffer +0x191 is 2, 3 (100..0x81) only in that case, 0 at frame 0) and start the slide-in timer (1, 10). Mode 10 only sets +0x12 and loads the players. No return value. Side effects: the panel, layouts, timer. Callers: 1 (ui_title_create_duel_setup_panel).

Fills the panel slots from the duel setup buffer (deck_get_duel_setup_buffer; player records of 0x1ac bytes from +0x1a4: character +0, variant +2, two halfwords +4/+6, deck +8, peer index +0xc, name +0x18, deck name +0x4a). Offline: mode 9 copies all four records (slot byte +0x20 set to 2 for characters > 1), modes 8/10 copy two (for mode 10 with a tag duel, buffer +0x192 == 2, slot 0 uses the first record whose character is the player, 1). Online (net active): finds the local peer's record (+0xc against system_net_api_get_local_peer_index) and orders the slots so the local team comes first (swapping pairs when the local index is odd); mode 9 copies four records (character 0 shown as 1), other modes two (the first player-controlled record of each team). All through ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_full with deck type 3. No return value. Side effects: the panel slots. Callers: 1 (ui_title_init_duel_setup_panel).

Stores mode in byte +0x11 of the duel setup panel 0x09aee300 (1 single, 3 tag team, 4 tag slots, 8-10 versus screens as used by the callers). No return value. Side effects: writes the panel. Callers: 5 (ui_title_reset_duel_setup_slots, ui_title_init_comm_player_slots, ui_title_enter_comm_single_duel, ui_title_update_comm_tag_duel, ...).

column2: void ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot(short slot, int character, int variant, int deck_type, int deck_id)
column3: Updates panel slot (0x09aee300 + 0x14 + slot * 0x18): non-negative character / variant are stored at +0 and +4 / +2 and +6, deck_type at +8, deck_id at +0xa. Then sets the deck name pointer +0x14: for the player (character 1) or character 0x2e, deck type 1 uses deck_get_recipe_name(deck_id), type 0 the stored deck name (save_get_stored_deck(deck_id - 1) + 4, or null for deck 0, the current deck), types 2/3 keep the pointer; other characters always use deck_get_recipe_name(deck_id). No return value. Side effects: the panel slot. Callers: 2 (ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_name, ui_title_apply_selected_deck).

column2: void ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_name(short slot, int character, int variant, int deck_type, int deck_id, ushort *name)
column3: ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot(slot, character, variant, deck_type, deck_id), then stores name (when not null) as the slot's player name pointer (+0x10 of the slot). No return value. Side effects: the panel slot. Callers: 5 (ui_title_init_comm_player_slots, ui_title_refresh_comm_player_slot, ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_deck_name, ui_title_update_comm_partner_pick, ...).

column2: void ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_deck_name(short slot, int character, int variant, int deck_type, int deck_id, ushort *name, ushort *deck_name)
column3: ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_name(...), then stores deck_name (when not null) as the slot's deck name pointer (+0x14 of the slot). No return value. Side effects: the panel slot. Callers: 3 (ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_full, ui_title_handle_comm_tag_team_input, ui_title_apply_selected_deck).

column2: void ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_full(short slot, int character, int variant, int deck_type, int deck_id, ushort *name, ushort *deck_name, short shown_character, short shown_variant)
column3: ui_title_set_duel_setup_slot_deck_name(...), then overwrites the slot's second character/variant pair (+4/+6 of the slot, the ones the icons draw) with shown_character / shown_variant (ninth argument on the stack). No return value. Side effects: the panel slot. Callers: 5 (ui_title_reset_duel_setup_slots, ui_title_update_wireless_tag_slots, ui_title_receive_wireless_entries, ui_title_set_wireless_own_slot, ...).

Copies the 0x18-byte panel slot (clamped to 3) to out. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 11 (ui_title_start_comm_duel, ui_title_step_comm_tag_slot_cursor, ui_title_enter_deck_select, ui_title_draw_comm_tag_duel, ...).

Starts the panel's frame timer at +0x74 (ui_title_init_frame_timer(panel + 0x74, kind, frames)); kind 1 slides the slots in, 2 out. No return value. Side effects: the timer. Callers: 6 (ui_title_init_duel_setup_panel, ui_title_update_duel_setup_panel, ui_title_enter_comm_single_duel, ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ...).

Wrapper: returns ui_title_update_duel_setup_panel(1) (the decompiler drops the return; callers test it for 1). Side effects: through the update. Callers: 3 (ui_title_update_comm_vs_layouts, ui_title_update_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_update_wireless_single_duel).

Advances the panel phase +0x0c: 0 starts a 15-frame black fade in (phase 1; ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel moves 1 -> 2); 2 plays sound 0x7a7e; 3 when layout 1 reaches its intro end (0x1d single / 0x81 tag) plays the loop ranges of layouts 1, 2 (and 3 for buffer +0x191 == 2) and goes to 4; 4 for modes 8-10 waits for the slide timer, then mode 9 plays layout 0 frames 0..0xe (phase 5) and others go to 6; for other modes returns 1 when the timer ends; 5 holds layout 0 at frame 0xe; 6 (modes 8/9) counts +0x08 up to 0x78 and, with allow_exit, then starts the slide-out timer (2, 10), sound 0x7a7f and the outro ranges (phase 7); 7 holds the layouts at their last frame (phase 8); 8 returns 1. Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: panel phase/counter, layouts, fade, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_title_call_update_duel_setup_panel).

Draws the duel setup panel: layouts 1 and 2 for modes 8/9 from phase 2; plays sound 0x7a81 / 0x7a82 at the slide frames of layout 1 (0x17/0x46 for modes 5/8, 0x7b/0xaa for 6/7/9); the slot frames and character icons, names, decks and team info (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_icons/_names/_decks/_info); for mode 9 layout 0 at (0, 0x19); for modes 8/9 with a tag buffer (+0x191 == 2) layout 3, and in phase 1 the fade (system_draw_fade), moving to phase 2 when it ends. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, sounds, panel phase. Callers: 5 (ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_draw_comm_tag_duel, ui_title_call_draw_duel_setup_panel, ui_title_draw_wireless_single_duel, ...).

Horizontal slide offset of a panel slot from the panel's frame timer (+0x74, ui_title_get_frame_timer -> kind, current, total): 0 when the timer is idle; left-side slots (slot 0 in modes 1/5/8, slots 0-1 otherwise) slide between -0x168 and 0, right-side slots between 0 and +0x168, linearly with current / total (kind 1 slides in, kind 2 out). No side effects. Callers: 4 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_names, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_icons, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_decks).

column2: void ui_title_bind_duel_setup_layout(int index, int mode, int start, int end)
column3: Looks up a panel layout in the panel's archive (+0x04) by name from the 0x40-byte name array 0x08ee8c44 (first entry d_menu_partner.ehf): for modes 8/9 index 1 uses name 2, index 2 name 3, index 3 name 4 + the halfword +0x34 of the duel setup tail block (deck_get_duel_setup_tail_block), index 0 name 0; stores it at panel +0x7c + index * 4 and sets its play range (ui_title_play_duel_setup_layout). No return value. Side effects: the panel layout pointers and players. Callers: 1 (ui_title_init_duel_setup_panel).

column2: void ui_title_play_duel_setup_layout(int index, int mode, int start, int end)
column3: Sets the play range of panel layout index (+0x7c + index * 4) when bound: modes 1/2 play start..end (ui_ehf_set_play_range(ehf, start, end + 1)), mode 0 holds frame start. No return value. Side effects: the layout player. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_duel_setup_panel, ui_title_bind_duel_setup_layout).
Returns the current frame of panel layout index (ui_ehf_get_current_frame), or -1 when unbound. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_title_update_duel_setup_panel, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel).

column2: int ui_title_set_duel_setup_layout_position(int index, short x, short y)
column3: Sets the position of panel layout index (ui_ehf_set_position). Returns its result, or 0 when unbound. Side effects: the layout player. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel).

Draws panel layout index when bound: zeroed 0x60-byte draw parameters whose first word is the frame timing value, ui_ehf_draw between ui_ehf_begin_draw and ui_ehf_end_draw. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, advances the player. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel).

True when mode is not 8-10, the panel's network-active byte (+0x10) is set and at least 3 peers are connected (system_net_api_get_peer_count), i.e. a wireless tag duel whose frames use the second colour set. No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_icons, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_decks).

Draws the icon frame of each panel slot (ui_title_draw_duel_menu_frame_default) and, for slots with a character and deck, the character icon 3 px inside (ui_title_draw_character_icon). Two slots for modes 1/5/8 (positions from 0x08ee8e04, moved down 10 px in mode 8 when +0x12 is set and save byte 0x16e10 > 0), two icons without frames for mode 10 (positions 0x08ee8e10), four slots otherwise (positions 0x08ee8e1c, frame ids 0x08ee8e2c alternating by team, second set for linked tag duels); modes 8/9 add a 0x19 px vertical offset; x includes the slide offset. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel).

Draws the name plate of each panel slot (frames 0x14 and 0x1b) and the player name (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_player_name, width 0x6d) with the slide offset: two slots for modes 1/5/8 (positions 0x08ee8e34), names only for mode 10 (0x08ee8e3c), four slots otherwise (0x08ee8e44; names hidden in mode 3); modes 8/9 add 0x19 px vertically. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_duel_setup_player_name(void *list, short *slot_chars, int x, int y, int width, int small)
column3: Draws the name for a panel slot (slot_chars points at the slot's second character/variant pair): the stored name pointer (+0x10 from it) for the player (character 1), otherwise world_call_get_character_name_string(0, character, variant); black at scale 0xe, or white at scale 0xc when small is set; centred in width. Nothing when the character is <= 0. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_names).

Draws the deck plate of each panel slot (frame from 0x08ee8e5c / 0x08ee8e74 by team, 0x94 x 0x17, plus frame 0x1a) and the deck name (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_deck_name, width 0x7b) with the slide offset: two slots for modes 1/5/8 (positions 0x08ee8e54), none for mode 10, four otherwise (0x08ee8e64; names hidden in mode 3); modes 8/9 add 0x19 px. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_duel_setup_deck_name(void *list, uint slot, short *slot_chars, int x, int y, int width)
column3: Draws a slot's deck name in white at scale 0xe, centred: in modes 5-7 an odd slot with fewer than 2 peers shows a fixed placeholder string (0x08ee8e7c); for the player / character 0x2e deck types 1-3 use the stored deck name pointer, type 0 with deck 0 the current deck name (deck_get_member_slot_name(0)); other characters type 3 the stored pointer, recipe ids below 0x1ce deck_get_recipe_name (cached in the slot), otherwise duelmenu_msg string 1. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state, may write the slot's deck name pointer. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_decks).

Draws the team information plates: for modes 2/3/4/6/9 the four slot frames (positions 0x08ee8e9c, frame ids 0x08ee8eac by slot and colour set); then, when the slide has finished and the panel shows teams (modes 2/3/4/6/9, or 8 with +0x12 set) and save byte 0x16e10 > 0 (when +0x12 is set), two team plates (frames from 0x08ee8ecc, 0xd3 x 0x17, inner frame 0x15 0xb9 x 0xe, icon frame 0x1c) with, for modes 8/9, the caption built by ui_title_build_duel_setup_caption (ui_title_draw_text_fit_width, width 0xb7), otherwise duelmenu_msg strings from 0x08ee8ee4 (3 and 2 for a two-peer linked mode 6 when this is not peer 0). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 2 (ui_title_draw_wireless_tag_duel, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_panel).

Builds a team caption into out (UTF-16): without the +0x12 flag, joins the two team members' names (the stored name for the player, otherwise ui_title_get_tn_text(character, variant, 1, member)) with a separator (0x08ee8eec), adding a duelmenu_msg suffix in Japanese; with the flag, team 0 uses the save's team name (save_get_team_name) and team 1 joins two tag-name text parts chosen from the partner's character values (save_get_character_value_bits1_3 / bits4_6, the weekly random bit for the order; in mode 8 the partner is save byte 0x16e10 with its variant looked up in the story block's 0x5c-byte records), with a duelmenu_msg suffix from the 6-entry table 0x08ee8ef0 in Japanese. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_character_icon(void *list, int mode, ushort character, ushort variant, short x, short y)
column3: Draws a character icon: when ui_title_get_character_icon_cell gives an icon cell (u, v) draws it as duel menu frame 0x16 (or 0x17 when world byte 0x3f of the character is >= 0x40); otherwise draws the face portrait (ui_title_draw_character_portrait). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_icons).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_character_portrait(void *list, short character, short x, short y)
column3: For x in -0x40..0x1df draws the character's face clipped to a 0x40 x 0x40 scissor at (x, y) (width cut at the screen edge): looks up kao.gim and karada.gim in the panel's archive and calls ui_title_call_draw_character_face(list, character, x - 9, y - 0x15, scale 0xa5, kao, karada). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_character_icon).

column2: bool ui_title_get_character_icon_cell(int mode, ushort character, ushort variant, short *out_u, short *out_v)
column3: For characters below 0x2e computes the 64 x 64 icon cell from world byte 0x3f (world_get_character_byte_3f; for the player in a networked panel the variant is incremented first): values >= 0x40 are reduced by 8, then index = value % 0x40, u = (index % 8) * 0x40, v = (index / 8) * 0x40. Returns true with the cell, false (no icon cell) for characters >= 0x2e. mode is not used. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_character_icon).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_duel_menu_frame_default(void *list, int frame, short x, short y)
column3: Draws duel menu frame frame at (x, y) with all size and texture parameters defaulted (-1): ui_title_draw_duel_menu_frame(list, frame, x, y, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 4 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_names, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_decks, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_icons).

Sets the GE state for 2D sprites: clear colour/depth/stencil 0, nearest texture filtering, enables states 9 and 4 (blending), disables 1 and 10, blend function (add, source alpha, one minus source alpha) and colour white. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 5 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_names, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info, ui_title_draw_character_grid, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_decks, ...).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_duel_menu_frame(void *list, int frame, short x, short y, short width, short height, short u, short v, short tex_w, short tex_h)
column3: Draws a duel menu frame from sprite parts (ui_title_draw_duel_menu_sprite): frames 0-8 are icon plates (parts 0-1 when no size is given, otherwise the nine-slice parts 2-10 of frame 9 sized width x height (0x47 default) plus part 1), frames 9-0x14 nine-slice boxes (parts 2-10), 0x15 a nine-slice box from parts 0x12-0x1a, 0x16/0x17 single parts 0xe/0xf (character icon backgrounds), 0x1a-0x1c part 0xd, 0x1d-0x24 part 0xb, others part 0. The last two arguments arrive on the stack. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 4 (ui_title_draw_character_icon, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_decks, ui_title_draw_duel_menu_frame_default).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_duel_menu_sprite(void *list, int frame, int part, short x, short y, short width, short height, short u, short v, short tex_w, short tex_h)
column3: Resolves the sprite (ui_title_get_duel_menu_sprite) for frame and part, binds its GIM from the panel archive by name (0x40-byte name array 0x08ee8f1c starting with d_menu01.gim) and draws it at the resolved position with the resolved size and texture coordinates (system_ge_set_sprite_extent, system_ge_draw_sprite_flipped). Arguments 9-11 arrive on the stack. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_duel_menu_frame).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_duel_menu_sprite_unbound(void *list, int frame, int part, short x, short y, short width, short height, short u, short v, short tex_w, short tex_h)
column3: Same as ui_title_draw_duel_menu_sprite without binding a texture (the caller has bound it): resolves the sprite parameters and draws the sprite. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_character_grid_faces, ui_title_draw_character_grid_cells, ui_title_draw_character_grid_variant_arrows).

column2: void ui_title_get_duel_menu_sprite(int frame, int part, ushort *io)
column3: Resolves a duel menu sprite in place. io holds {gim, x, y, width, height, u, v, tex_w, tex_h}: gim is set from the part's record in the 5-halfword table 0x08ee90dc (copied to the stack), negative u/v/tex_w/tex_h take the record's defaults, negative width/height the texture size. Per frame family it applies offsets: frames 0-8 part 1 is inset by 3 px and its u shifted by frame * 4 (and width/height reduced by 7 when given); frames 9-0x14 and 0x15 lay the nine-slice parts out (corners/edges at x + 4 or x + width - tex_w, y + 4 or y + height - 5, stretched centre and edges width - 9 / height - 9) with u shifted by 10 per colour variant; frame 0x14 uses colour 0x12 with a fixed 0x88 x 0x17 size; 0x1a-0x1c shift u by 0x11 per frame; 0x1d-0x24 shift v by 0x18 per frame (0x21+ also u + 0x30). No return value. Side effects: writes io. Callers: 2 (ui_title_draw_duel_menu_sprite_unbound, ui_title_draw_duel_menu_sprite).
Clears a frame timer (byte kind +0, halfword current +2, halfword total +4). No return value. Side effects: writes the timer. Callers: 1 (ui_title_step_frame_timer).

column2: void ui_title_init_frame_timer(void *timer, uchar kind, short total)
column3: Starts a frame timer: kind at +0, current 0 at +2, total at +4. No return value. Side effects: writes the timer. Callers: 1 (ui_title_start_duel_setup_timer).

Advances a frame timer: returns true when it is idle (kind 0) or has reached its total (and then resets it), otherwise increments current and returns false. Side effects: writes the timer. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_duel_setup_panel).
Reads a frame timer: stores current (+2) and total (+4) and returns the kind byte (+0; 0 idle). Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (ui_title_get_duel_setup_slide_offset).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_text_aligned(void *list, int x, int y, int width, ushort *text, int align)
column3: Draws a UTF-16 string in a box of width: align 3 centres it when it is narrower than the box and draws it fitted to the width (ui_title_draw_text_fit_width); align 2 draws it fitted from x; align 1 centres it at its natural width (ui_title_draw_text); align 0 draws it plainly; other values draw nothing. Widths come from system_font_measure_string (1/64 px). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 10 (ui_title_draw_name_entry, ui_title_draw_wireless_list_item, ui_title_draw_deck_select_entry, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_player_name, ...).

Returns string index of duelmenu_msg_<l>.bin from the duel setup panel's archive: the member name is taken from the 0x80-byte name array 0x08ee91ec (duelmenu_msg_j.bin first) by the save language, then card_db_get_dictionary_word(member, index). No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_deck_name, ui_title_build_duel_setup_caption).

column2: void * ui_title_draw_text_fit_width(void *list, int x, int y, int width, ushort *text)
column3: Opens an external font list on list, draws text fitted into width + 2 px (ui_title_draw_text_fit_width_px) and closes the list. Returns the advanced display list (system_font_end_external_list). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 3 (ui_title_draw_text_aligned, ui_title_draw_text_with_align, ui_title_draw_duel_setup_info).

column2: int ui_title_draw_text_fit_width_px(int x, int y, int width, ushort *text)
column3: Read from the disassembly (Ghidra shows an empty body): pixel-to-font-unit wrapper that shifts x, y and width left by 6 (1/64-pixel units) and tail-jumps to the import stub of system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) (vram_offset -1 in t0). column2: void ui_mini_result_create(void *heap, void *archive, int game, uint *score)
column3: Allocates the 0x2c4-byte mini-game result block from heap (pointer in 0x09aee308), stores heap (+0), initialises its menu context at +0x54 with archive, stores the game index (+0x20), applies the score when given (ui_mini_result_apply_score) and initialises the screen (ui_mini_result_init). No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, 0x09aee308, save (through apply_score). Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_mini_result).

When the result block 0x09aee308 exists, resets its list window (+0x1a4, ui_list_window_reset), frees it on its heap and clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: heap free, 0x09aee308. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_mini_result).

Scores a finished mini-game into the result block 0x09aee308 and the save: stores the score values (+0x28 / +0x2c / +0x40) and writes the main score to world_get_minigame_score(); base DP (+0x30) per game: 0 score / 50, 1 score / 150, 2 score / 2 plus ceil(sub / 100) when the flag word score[2] is set, 3 score / 10, 4 score[1] * 20 + score[2] * 150, 5 score / 50, 6 score / 10; each new record (compared with save_get_minigame_record_N, records 0..8) adds 200 bonus DP (+0x34), stores the record (save_set_minigame_record_N), sets the new-record flags (+0x44/+0x46) and a marker byte in the save record table (+0xec.. by record). Total DP +0x38 = base + bonus, experience +0x3c = total / 25; adds the DP (save_add_dp) and experience (save_add_duelist_exp) and 400 more DP when that reports a level up. Games 3 and 4 also store the from-story flag (+0x1c, ui_mini_result_is_from_story). No return value. Side effects: the result block, save records, DP and experience, the world score. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_create).

Binds the result screen's context layouts (0: frames 0..0x10, 1: 0..0x1df) and images 0 and 1, sets step +0xc = 1 and starts a 16-frame black fade in. No return value. Side effects: the result block, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_create).
Returns ui_mini_result_update_main() in mode +8 = 0, otherwise 1. Side effects: through the update. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_mini_result).

Step handler of the result screen (+0xc): 2 waits for the intro, 3 handles input, 4 updates the message window, 5 reads layout 0's frame (the fade in ui_mini_result_draw moves it to 6), 6 returns the result +0x24 (2 or 3); steps 0/1 wait for the fade. Returns 1 while running, 0 for unknown steps. Side effects: through the handlers. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_update).

Step 2: when context layout 0 reaches frame 0x10 switches it to the loop 0x11..0x60; from frame 0x10 on sets step 3. No return value. Side effects: the layout, step. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_update_main).

Step 3: on a face button (ui_mini_result_poll_face_buttons): when the game was launched from the story (+0x1c == 1) sets result 3, fades the BGM out, plays layout 0 frames 0x61..0x65, step 5 and a black fade out; otherwise sets step 4, result 3 and opens a message window with mini_result string 0xd (ui_menu_ctx_open_message_window(heap, window +0x1a4, text, 0, 1), three choices). No return value. Side effects: the block, window, BGM, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_update_main).
True when any face button (pad pressed bits 0xf000) was pressed, playing sound 0x7a05. Side effects: sound. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_handle_input).

Step 4: updates the window +0x1a4; result 2 sets the outcome +0x24 = 2 (play again, hypothesis medium), 3 or -2 sets 3; when the window has closed (state byte +0x28d == 6) plays layout 0 frames 0x36..0x65, sets step 5, fades out and fades the BGM. No return value. Side effects: the block, layout, fade, BGM. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_update_main).

Step 5 handler: reads the frame of context layout 0; the decompiled body discards it and has no side effects (name suggests a test for frame 0x65; hypothesis, confidence low). Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_update_main).

Draws the result screen: context layout 1, layout 0 from step 2, the header, panels and labels/values, the message window centred at step 4; drives the fades (step 5 -> 6 and step 1 -> 2 when system_draw_fade finishes). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, step. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_mini_result).
At steps 3 and 4, with context image 1 bound, draws its part 0xd at (0x70, 8). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_draw).

With context image 0 bound draws the result panels: a border box (0x3e, 0x3d, 0x165 x 0xa4), two sections (y 0x40 and 0x79) each with a title bar and value box (nine-slices colours 1 and 4) and two rows (colour 3 label box 0x10d x 0x10, colour 1 value box 0x49 x 0x10, plus the new-record mark part 0xc at (0x14a, y + 3) for rows of the first section whose flag +0x44/+0x46 is set), two three-slice bars with value boxes at y 0xb3/0xc8 and the bottom bar (colour 8, y 0x100, 0x1e2 x 0x12). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_draw).

Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_draw).

Draws the six result values (+0x28..+0x3c) right-aligned at x 0x155 with digit glyph strings from 0x15 (ui_menu_ctx_draw_number): rows at y 0x54/0x67, 0x8d/0xa0 and 0xb9/0xce; widths 0x47 or 0x33; at least 6 digits for the first two, 5 for the others; the second value only for games 2 (as a time, mode 2) and 4 (when +0x40 is set). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_draw_labels).

True when the mini-game scene (0x15 for game 4, 0x18 for game 3, 0 otherwise) was called from scene 2 (system_scene_get_caller); false when called from scene 0xd (the title) or anything else. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_mini_result_apply_score).

Allocates the 0x2dc-byte mini-game menu block from heap (pointer in 0x09aee30c), stores heap, initialises its menu context at +0x6c with archive and initialises the menu (ui_minigame_menu_init). No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, 0x09aee30c. Callers: 1 (ui_title_enter_minigame_menu).

Clears bits 0-1 of 0x08eeda48 and, when the menu block 0x09aee30c exists, resets its list window (+0x1bc), frees it and clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: heap free, 0x08eeda48, 0x09aee30c. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_minigame_menu).

Binds the title bar layout 0xe (0..0x10), context layout 5 (0..0x1df) and images 2, 3, 4, builds the unlocked game list (ui_minigame_menu_build_list), sets step +0xc = 1 and starts a 16-frame black fade in. No return value. Side effects: the menu block, layouts, fade. Callers: 2 (ui_minigame_menu_create, ui_minigame_menu_update_list).
True when any mini-game unlock flag is set: save progress flags 0xe8 bits 2-7 or 0xe9 bit 6. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_title_init_main_menu).

Reads the seven unlock flags into +0x50..+0x68 (game 0 = flag 0xe8 bit 2, 1 = bit 3, 2 = bit 4, 3 = bit 6, 4 = bit 5, 5 = bit 7, 6 = flag 0xe9 bit 6) and lists the unlocked game indices in +0x28.. with the count in +0x4c. No return value. Side effects: the menu block. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_init).

Update of the mini-game menu by mode +8: 0 the game list (ui_minigame_menu_update_list), 1 the opponent selection, 2 launches the game (ui_minigame_menu_launch_game) and returns 2; 3 returns 1. Returns the handler's result. Side effects: through the handlers. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_minigame_menu).

Step handler of the game list (+0xc): 0 re-initialises, 2 waits for the bar animation (step 3), 3 handles input, 5 counts +0x18 past 0x1e frames then fades out (step 6), 6 waits (stub), 7 returns ui_minigame_menu_route_selection(); 1 and 4 wait for fades. Returns 1 while running, 0 for unknown steps. Side effects: the block, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_update).

Opponent selection for a mini-game (+0xc): 0 uses the already loaded character list module when bit 4 of 0x08eeda48 is set, otherwise requests module 0xd with the loading overlay (step 1); 1 waits for the module; 2 opens the character list in mode 5 on the title heap; 3 updates it: cancel closes it and goes to step 4 (back to the game list, mode 0), a choice stores the character/variant in +0x44/+0x48, closes it and goes to step 5 (mode 2, launch). Returns 1. Side effects: module loading, 0x08eeda48/0x08eeda4c, the block, character list. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_update).
Sets step +0xc = 3 once the bar layout has opened (ui_title_get_menu_bar_anim_phase() != 0). No return value. Side effects: the block. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_update_list).

Step 3 of the game list: polls the cursor (ui_minigame_menu_poll_cursor); 2 (cancel) sets step 6, outcome +0x20 = 3 and fades out; 1 (chosen) sets step 5, outcome 2 and the chosen game +0x24 = the listed index at the cursor (+0x28 + cursor * 4). No return value. Side effects: the block, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_update_list).

Cursor input of the mini-game list (cursor +0x14 over the +0x4c listed games): down/up (pressed or repeat) move with wrap and sound 0x7a04; confirm (with at least one game) sets bits 0-1 of 0x08eeda48 to 1, plays 0x7a05 and returns 1; cancel plays 0x7a06 and returns 2; otherwise returns 0. Side effects: cursor, 0x08eeda48, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_handle_input).
Empty step handler (step 6 of the mini-game list, waiting for the fade that ui_minigame_menu_draw_main completes). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_update_list).

Step 7 of the game list: when a game was chosen (outcome +0x20 == 2) games 0, 1, 2, 5, 6 go to the opponent selection (mode 1) and games 3, 4 straight to the launch (mode 2), returning 1; otherwise (cancel) unloads the library module when bit 4 of 0x08eeda48 is set and returns 3. Side effects: the menu block, module unload. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_update_list).

Fills the chosen game's world parameter block with the opponent (+0x44 character, +0x48 variant; remaining words -1/0, some with a final 1) and switches scene: game 0 blackjack params -> scene 0xf, 1 dodge -> 0x11, 2 connection -> 0x13, 3 (no parameters) -> 0x18, 4 underground params (first word 0) -> 0x15, 5 reversi -> 0x19, 6 throw (word 4 = 1) -> 0x1c (world_get_*_params). Unloads the library module first when bit 4 of 0x08eeda48 is set, then ui_title_switch_scene(scene, 0). No return value. Side effects: world parameter blocks, module unload, scene switch. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_update).
Draws the game list (ui_minigame_menu_draw_main) while the menu is in mode 0. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

Draws the mini-game list screen: context layout 5, the title bar layout 0xe with its label, the panel and the labels, the window +0x1bc centred at step 4; at step 6 when the fade ends clears bits 0-1 of 0x08eeda48 and sets step 7; at step 1 moves to step 2 when the fade ends. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, step, 0x08eeda48. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_draw).
Draws the character list (ui_charalist_draw) while the mini-game menu is in mode 1 step 3. No return value. Side effects: drawing. Callers: 1 (ui_title_draw_state).

With context image 2 bound draws the list panel (nine-slice kind 2 colour 0xd at (0x59, 0x40) 0x12f x 0xb5), one row box per listed game (colour 0x15 at (0x5f, 0x46 + i * 0x18) 0x122 x 0x17) and, from step 3, a pulsing cursor frame on the selected row. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_draw_main).

Draws the footer text (message table 6 + language, string 0x59, centred at y 0x100) and, for each listed game, its name (string 0x52 + game index) in black at (0x63, 0x4a + row * 0x18), scale 0xe. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_minigame_menu_draw_main).

Loads the card trade resources by third level 0x08eea3e8: 0 clears the trade records (0x08eec05c, 0xa4 bytes), resets the popup message, sets the cursor words (0x08eeac70 = 2, 4 positions, 5 cards) and requests module 0x1d (card picker; 0x08eeda4c, bit 5 of 0x08eeda48) with the loading overlay; 1 waits for it (trade flag bit 0); 2 allocates 0x135000 bytes and opens cardh.cip (card_db_open_cardh_cip); 3 waits for it; 4 opens the card view (ui_card_view_open with GIMs 0xb, 0xc, 0xd, 0xe and layout 3 of the title_menu archive and the cardh reader), allocates 0x5e5000 bytes and opens cardm.cip; 5 waits for it, sets trade flag bit 1, hides the overlay, binds layout 7 and returns 1. Returns 0 while loading. Side effects: heap allocations (0x08eec0d4/0x08eec0d8), card readers 0x08eec0cc/0x08eec0d0, module loading, trade flags 0x08eec0dc. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update).

Per-frame link logic of the card trade (sub-states 0xe and 0xf of the wireless state): reads the peers' trade records (ui_card_trade_read_peer_messages), resends the local offer when the peer's card list arrived, clears the peer list when its card images are not ready, and advances the third level 0x08eea3e8 when both sides reach the same status (system_net_api_is_synced with own record 0x08eec094 and peer record 0x08eec0b0 statuses 8, 9, 10, 0xd: 0x13 -> 0x14, 0x18 -> 0x1a, 0x1c -> 0x20 after posting the remaining offer list, 0x20 -> 0x21) or the peer reports an error (status 0xc sets trade flag bit 4); handles the send/acknowledge steps 0xf/0x10/0x11 (resend status 0 or 6 until the peer echoes it, then restore the pending step/level). The link phase byte 0x08eead89 (7, 8, 9) selects the checks. No return value. Side effects: step/level words, trade records and flags, network sends. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless_handshake).

Sends the local trade record as a 0x20-byte game packet 0x08eebacc: +0 = 2, +2 = 1, +3 = step (kept when step is 0), +4.. the 0x1c-byte record 0x08eec05c; on success sets the network sync target (system_net_api_set_sync_target(2, 1, step)) and the link phase 0x08eead89 = 8 for step 7. Returns true when system_net_api_send_game_data accepted it. Side effects: packet buffer, network send, sync target. Callers: 14 (ui_card_trade_post_offer_list, ui_card_trade_update_card_select, ui_card_trade_post_status_4, ui_card_trade_post_status, ...).

Copies the 0x1c-byte trade record of every peer packet whose first byte is 2 into the own echo 0x08eec094 (local peer) or the peer record 0x08eec0b0; when both packets carry step 7 (host) or steps 8/7 (guest) posts status 6 (ui_card_trade_post_status_6); when the other peer's packet carries step 0xe sets the third level to 5 (partner left). No return value. Side effects: the received records, posting, level word. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_link).

Posts trade status 4 (selection cleared: record +0x18/+0x19 = 0) with packet step 6; step 0x11 (wait for echo) when sent, else 0xf (retry); pending step 0xb, level 2; link phase 0x08eead89 = 7 and the animation counter 0x08eec0de cleared. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step/pending words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Posts trade status 8 (accept the exchange) with packet step 10; step 0x11 or 0xf (retry); pending step 0xb, level 0x13. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step/pending words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Posts trade status status with packet step 0xb; step 0x11 or 0xf (retry); pending step 0xb, level = current level + 1. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step/pending words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Posts trade status 0xc (error/abort) with packet step 0xc; step 0x11 or 0xf; pending step 0xb, pending level next_level (current + 2 when 0); when trade flag bit 4 is already set (the peer failed too) moves directly to step 0xb with that level. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step/level words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Performs the agreed exchange in the save: the received card is the peer's card at the own selection index (0x08eec0b8[0x08eec0ad], stored in 0x08eec0a8), the given card the own card at the peer's selection index (0x08eec09c[0x08eec0c9], stored in 0x08eec0c4); removes one given card (save_change_card_count(id, 0)), adds the received one (save_change_card_count(id, 1)) and journals both (save_write_title_words(0, given, received)) so the exchange can be reverted. No return value. Side effects: save card counts and title words. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Undoes a journalled exchange after a failed save: reads the title words (save_read_title_words) into the given/received ids 0x08eec0c4/0x08eec0a8, adds the given card back and removes the received one. No return value. Side effects: save card counts, those globals. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Posts trade status 1 (proposal confirmed, selection cleared) with packet step 0xd; step 0x11 or 0xf; pending step 0xb, level 3. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step/pending words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_handle_select_input).

Posts trade status 2 with packet step 0xe (leave the trade, hypothesis medium); step 0x11 or 0xf; pending step 0xb, level + 1. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step/pending words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Posts trade status 6 with packet step 8 (both sides selected; start the exchange animation); step 0x11 or 0xf; pending step 0xb, level 7. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step/pending words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_read_peer_messages).

Posts trade status 4 (selection cleared) with packet step 6 like ui_card_trade_post_status_4, but stays on step 0xb when sent (0xf otherwise) and keeps the current step/level as the pending ones; link phase 7, animation counter cleared. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

After an exchange, posts the updated offer list: copies the five own card ids from the echo record (0x08eec09c) into the local record (0x08eec064), removing the entry the peer took (index 0x08eec0c9) and shifting the rest down, count = old count - 1, status 0xd, packet step 0x10 then sends with step 6; step 0x11 or 0xf; pending step 0xb, level 0x21. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, step words, network send. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_link).

Step handler of the card trade screen (wireless sub-state, step 0x08eea3e4): 1 loads the resources and then binds layout 0x12 (0..0x11), hides the overlay and fades in; 2 waits for the fade; 3/4 rebind layout 0x12; 5 starts its loop (0x12..0x35) at frame 0x11 and goes to step 0xb; 0xb and 0xe-0x11 run ui_card_trade_update_steps once the link phase 0x08eead89 > 6; 0x12 requests pending sub-state 0xf (card picker) and clears trade flags bits 6-7; 0x1c requests the exit (ui_title_request_state_with_step(1, 0xfff, 0xfff, 0x20)); 0x1e returns to the pending sub-state; 0x20 polls the wireless session (ui_title_poll_wireless_session(2, 0)) and goes to 0x22. No return value. Side effects: step words, layouts, fades, overlay, network. Callers: 1 (ui_title_update_wireless).

Third-level state machine of the card trade (0x08eea3e8), driving popup messages in the list window 0x08eea594 (tushin_msg strings 0x80, 0x71-0x7c, 0x81): 0-1 intro popups then status 3 (open the card picker); 2 card selection input; 3 confirm popup 0x72 (yes posts status 2, no returns to 2); 5/6 partner-left popup 0x79 then exit (step 0x1c); 7/8/10/0x15 timed animation steps; 9 / 0xb / 0xd accept-or-decline popup 0x73 (decline posts status 4, accept status 8; the peer's status 4 cancels the popup and resumes); 0xc/0xe declined popup 0x7a then status 4; 0xf/0x10 reset popup 0x7c then status 0; 0x11/0x12 popup 0x7b then status 3; 0x13/0x14 waiting popups 0x74; 0x16/0x17 journals the selection (save_write_title_words(1, ...)), saves (save_open(8), save_update_task: 3 failure posts status 0xc, 2 success posts status 9); 0x18 waits; 0x1a/0x1b applies the exchange and saves again (success posts status 10, failure status 0xc -> level 0x1e); 0x1e/0x1f reverts the exchange and saves (status 0xb on success); 0x19/0x1d error popup 0x81 then exit; 0x20 waits for an error; 0x21 completion popup 0x77 then status 4. Network-sensitive steps toggle system_net_set_word_bafc(0/1) around saving. No return value. Side effects: popups, save writes, trade records and flags, network sends, step words. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update).

Advances the timed trade animation steps: steps 7, 8, 10 last 0xf frames and step 0x15 lasts 0x5a frames (counter 0x08eec0de), then the third level moves to the next step (resetting 0x08eec0e8 when reaching 0xb). At step 0xb up/down (repeat) toggle the viewed side 0x08eeac70 (0/1), and the focused card and analog scroll are updated. No return value. Side effects: level word, counters, cursor, focused card. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Level 2 of the trade: polls the cursor (ui_card_trade_poll_cursor); confirm on a peer card (side 0) with a card: if it is already the own selection, deselects it (status 4); with no own cards offered goes to level 1; otherwise selects it: status 5, record +0x18 = 1, +0x19 = index, packet step 7 (step 0x11 or 0xf, pending step 0xb, level 2). Button 2 (left button) posts status 3 (change own offer), button 3 (right button) status 1 (confirm); cancel with a selection deselects it (status 4). Updates the focused card. No return value. Side effects: the trade record, network sends, step words. Callers: 1 (ui_card_trade_update_steps).

Sets the focused card id 0x08eec0e0 shown in the card detail view: before level 9 the card under the cursor (own list 0x08eec09c for side 1, stored also in 0x08eec0a8; peer list 0x08eec0b8 for side 0, also in 0x08eec0c4); from level 9 the selected cards (own card at the peer's selection index, peer card at the own selection index). 0 becomes -1 (none). No return value. Side effects: 0x08eec0e0, 0x08eec0a8, 0x08eec0c4. Callers: 2 (ui_card_trade_handle_select_input, ui_card_trade_advance_timed_steps).

Clears the local offer count 0x08eec060 and the five offered card ids 0x08eec064. No return value. Side effects: those globals. Callers: 2 (ui_title_handle_wireless_lobby_input, ui_card_trade_post_status_3).
